globaltix_product_data.description: Westminster Abbey situated on the north bank of the River Thames in London, next to the Houses of Parliament, is a magnificent Royal Catholic Cathedral in the Gothic style, a holy place in England, and prominent among the many churches in the country. The coronation throne of Edward I is located behind the church altar. This dilapidated seat has witnessed the changes of the British royal family for hundreds of years.

Stroll through the British State Burial Mausoleum and visit the resting places of royal family members and legendary figures such as Newton, Darwin, and Churchi
Visit the place on the north bank of the Thames where kings were crowned and royal family members held weddings

globaltix_product_data.name: Wineglass Bay Cruises Including Sky Lounge
globaltix_product_data.summary: Relax in the sky lounge during a 4 hour Wineglass Bay Cruise from Coles Bay to explore Tasmania's breathtaking coastline, granite peaks and shimmering beaches in comfort and style. Embark on a relaxing journey that will take you past rugged landscapes, pristine white sand beaches and secluded inlets...
globaltix_product_data.description: Relax in the sky lounge during a 4 hour Wineglass Bay Cruise from Coles Bay to explore Tasmania's breathtaking coastline, granite peaks and shimmering beaches in comfort and style. Embark on a relaxing journey that will take you past rugged landscapes, pristine white sand beaches and secluded inlets with special wildlife encounters with Little Penguins, Australian Fur Seals and migrating whales. Cruising on the Schouten Passage II, passengers of the Sky Lounge have free reign of the spacious adults-only lounge with banquette style seating for 26 passengers and a private viewing deck. Throughout the Wineglass Bay Cruise, you’ll enjoy a smorgasbord of oysters, salmon, smoked meats and bread accompanied by wine and artisan beer as the incredible scenery passes by. This premium cruise with access to the sky lounge guarantees an intimate experience and a unique perspective to view Wineglass Bay. During selected months, you may even see Humpback or Southern Right Whales and Albatross migrating through the region. As one of our top things to do in Tasmania, you simply don't want to miss out on this extraordinary experience. The adventure begins from Coles Bay.

Wildlife spotting
Enjoy morning tea, smorgasbord lunch & beverages
Exclusive access to the adults only Sky Lounge
Access to the Captains bridge & private viewing deck
Sparkling white beaches, hidden caves & more

globaltix_product_data.summary: Penang Wonderfood Museum presents a kitsch, kooky and in-depth look at the city’s unique food culture with larger-than-life displays of Malaysian dishes. Set within a 1940s colonial building in Georgetown, the museum is divided into three galleries - Info Zone, Wow Zone, and Educational Zone. All of...
globaltix_product_data.description: Penang Wonderfood Museum presents a kitsch, kooky and in-depth look at the city’s unique food culture with larger-than-life displays of Malaysian dishes. Set within a 1940s colonial building in Georgetown, the museum is divided into three galleries - Info Zone, Wow Zone, and Educational Zone. All of the hyper-realistic models are handcrafted by the museum’s owner, Sean Lao who uses Japanese food replication techniques. The museum features over 100 exhibits of local dishes, ranging from street food to traditional dishes, presented in a realistic and interactive way. The exhibits are arranged in different sections, each showcasing a particular aspect of Penang's food culture. For example, one section displays the ingredients and spices commonly used in Penang cuisine, while another section features the various utensils and equipment used in preparing and serving the dishes. Visitors can also learn about the history and cultural significance of each dish, as well as the cooking techniques and recipes involved in preparing them. The museum offers an immersive experience that allows visitors to see, touch, and even smell the exhibits, making it an excellent way to discover and appreciate the unique flavors of Penang. Overall, the Penang Wonderfood Museum is a must-visit destination for foodies and anyone interested in learning more about the culinary culture of Penang. It is open daily from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM and admission fees apply.
highlights: The Wonderfood Museum in Penang is a unique museum that features oversized replicas of traditional Malaysian dishes.
Oversized Food Replicas: The museum showcases a variety of food on display, providing you with an in-depth understanding of the foods popular in Asia.
Multi-Cultural Delicacies: Discover interesting delicacies arising from Malaysia’s multi-cultural background at the museum’s three galleries.
Interactive Exhibits: The exhibits at Wonderfood Museum are replicated with the utmost detail and are sure to tempt your appetite.

globaltix_product_data.description: Discover the story behind the world's most iconic beverage at this beloved Atlanta attraction. Located in Pemberton Place right next to the Georgia Aquarium, the World of Coca-Cola brings over 135 years of brand history to life across 11 interactive exhibition areas. From the legendary secret formula to a global tasting experience, it is a fun and immersive stop for soda lovers, history buffs, and families alike. The Coca-Cola Museum is located in Atlanta's Pemberton Square, adjacent to the Georgia State Aquarium, which opened in November 2005. The land on which the aquarium is located was also donated by The Coca-Cola Company. In addition, Coca-Cola donated more than 10,000 square meters of land to the Atlanta local department for the construction of the Civil Rights Museum. Pemberton Square is within walking distance of many attractions, including Central Olympic Park, making it easy for tourists to visit. The Coca-Cola Museum is a collection and reproduction of the infinite charm of Coca-Cola. It not only depicts the present of the Coca-Cola Company, but also depicts the infinite vision of the Coca-Cola Company for the future. Among them, more than 1,000 kinds of Coca-Cola handicrafts are exhibited to meet the world. The building strictly adheres to the U.S. Green Building Council's energy-efficient and environmentally friendly design standards and is one of the few green buildings in Georgia.

globaltix_product_data.description: Yehliu Geopark is a unique coastal geological park famous for its otherworldly rock formations shaped by wind and sea erosion over thousands of years. Located along the northern coast of Taiwan, the park features a wide range of natural sculptures, including the iconic “Queen’s Head,” attracting visitors from around the world. It offers a scenic and educational experience, combining natural beauty with fascinating geological history.
highlights: See the iconic “Queen’s Head” rock formation
Explore unusual mushroom-shaped and honeycomb rocks
Enjoy coastal views along dramatic rock landscapes
Learn about geological processes and erosion
Great for photography and sightseeing

globaltix_product_data.description: YONA Beach is a state-of-the-art multi-level Beach Club, offering a one-of-a-kind experience where guests can indulge in great food and drinks, A-list DJ’s, a 22-meter-long infinity pool, a wide variety of seating and lounging options, and a 360-degree ocean view. Have you ever dreamed of a floating oasis located on the Andaman Sea YONA Beach made the dream a reality with the most amazing beach club concept worldwide. Choose your vibe : Morning Chill Ambiance or Afternoon Party Atmosphere The morning experience offer a chill vibe, family friendly, including live singer entertainment, for someone looking to relax and enjoy the perfect lunch with stunning sea view. It’s also an ideal moment to take nice photos. (Morning : 9:30 AM until 2 PM, last check in 12 PM. Guests must depart Yona by 2 PM. Minimum age 4 years old) While the afternoon experience is for adult only on Yona offer an epic party vibe with DJ and entertainment, offer both option of lunch and dinner experience. Let’s not forget the incredible sunset and more time to have fun. (Afternoon : 2 PM until 9:30 PM, last check in 5 PM. Guests must depart Yona by 9:30 PM, Minimum age 20 years old)
highlights: Choose your vibe : Morning Chill Ambiance or Afternoon Party Atmosphere
Enjoy the resident DJ's set and the cutting-edge sound and lighting system
Refresh yourself in the infinity pool with a breathtaking view of the sea
Admire panoramic sea views from the club's restaurant and dine in luxury
Take in a magical sunset and dance until the sun goes down
inclusions: 1,500 THB credits for food and beverage (*Credit to spend on area, can be use on food and beverage from the beach club menu. Restaurant access is subject to availability, reservation is highly recommended.)

globaltix_product_data.summary: Indulge in Sky Dining and enjoy a romantic night under the stars in the heart of Singapore, only at the Singapore Flyer. With an in-flight host at your service throughout the hour-long experience, you and your special someone can savour the gorgeous views of Marina Bay at night for a truly elevated...
globaltix_product_data.description: Indulge in Sky Dining and enjoy a romantic night under the stars in the heart of Singapore, only at the Singapore Flyer. With an in-flight host at your service throughout the hour-long experience, you and your special someone can savour the gorgeous views of Marina Bay at night for a truly elevated dining experience. Make your Sky Dining experience at the Singapore Flyer a private affair. Escape, if only just for a moment, when you book yourself an exclusive experience perfect for couples and groups. Against the backdrop of Singapore’s glimmering night time skyline, treat that special someone to an unforgettable night and set the mood to pop the big question or celebrate an anniversary. Take partnerships to the next level with a one-of-a-kind business dinner meeting up in the skies. Entertain your guests in this unique and intimate, yet luxuriously spacious meeting venue to show your appreciation for your closest business partners. THE EXPERIENCE Three rotations aboard the Singapore Flyer (90 minutes), offering a leisurely dinner experience with breathtaking views Priority boarding from the VIP Lounge, with your personal host escorting you and your guests into our exquisitely spacious capsule. A constantly evolving amuse-bouche (chef's selection of the night), followed by a four-course dinner of your choice, curated with the finest ingredients A bottle of house wine (choice of red or white) to complement your dinner An exclusive Singapore Flyer souvenir for each guest Complimentary admission to Time Capsule following your dinner Complimentary parking coupons
highlights: Air-conditioned dining capsules with comfortable seating and a table.
Panoramic views of the city skyline from the comfort of a specially designed capsule.
Unique dining experience on board one of the world's largest observation wheels.
Four-course meal featuring the best of Singaporean cuisine.
Option to add on a premium champagne flight with additional snacks.
inclusions: Your evening begins in the VIP Lounge, where you will be checked-in and personally escorted to our exquisitely spacious capsule, setting the perfect ambience for special occasions.
Sip on a diverse selection of Nespresso Coffee or Gryphon Tea to cleanse your palate.
As the icing on the cake, take home a limited-edition Singapore Flyer souvenir to relish the memories created under the dazzling night sky.
Kickstart your 90-minute culinary adventure by exciting your taste buds with a constantly evolving amuse-bouche (chef's selection of the night), followed by a starter and an appetiser.
After your dinner, embark on a multisensorial journey through the Singapore story with complimentary admission to Time Capsule.
Round off the night on a sweet note with a delectable dessert and a petit four crafted by Singapore's internationally acclaimed chocolatier, Janice Wong.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Children under 7 years old are not permitted in shared capsules. You must book a private capsule if your group consists of 5 diners or more, or includes children under 7 years old. All guests, including those aged 7 to 12, will be charged the full price of 165 Sky Dining Valentine's Day Special. Outside food and drinks are prohibited, with a corkage fee applicable for guests intending to bring their own bottles. To ensure a safe and delightful experience, bookings may be rescheduled or cancelled in the event of flight suspension due to inclement weather. For dietary restrictions, special arrangements and rescheduling requests, kindly email singapore flyer customer service at customer_service@singaporeflyer.com at least 3 days before your reserved dinner. Please note that Singapore Flyer do not provide refunds for cancellations or rescheduling in the event of a no-show. Singapore Flyer management reserves the right to substitute any of the product inclusions with another product or service of similar value.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Soaring 300 metres above the streets of Osaka, Harukas 300 is the observation deck of Abeno Harukas. globaltix_product_data.description: Soaring 300 metres above the streets of Osaka, Harukas 300 is the observation deck of Abeno Harukas. Japan's tallest skyscraper, located in the vibrant Tennoji and Abeno district of southern Osaka. Occupying the 58th, 59th, and 60th floors of this iconic mixed-use tower, the observatory offers one of the most breathtaking urban panoramas in the country, spanning the entire Osaka cityscape, Osaka Bay, and on exceptionally clear days, the distant mountains of Nara and Kyoto. Designed as a fully immersive sky experience, Harukas 300 goes far beyond a standard observation deck. The 60th floor features an open-air Tenbō Terrace, a wraparound sky walk with glass floor panels that place guests literally above the clouds, while the indoor floors below offer sky lounges, a museum, souvenir shops, and a café where visitors can relax and take in the view at their own pace. Whether you visit by day for sweeping cityscapes or by evening for Osaka's glittering nightscape, Harukas 300 delivers a truly unforgettable aerial perspective of one of Japan's most dynamic cities.
highlights: Ascend to 300 metres atop Japan's tallest skyscraper for unobstructed 360-degree panoramic views across Osaka and beyond.
Experience the iconic glass-floored Tenbō Terrace — an open-air sky walk offering an exhilarating view straight down to the city below.
On clear days, views extend to Awaji Island, Kyoto, and even Mount Kongo — one of the most sweeping cityscapes in all of Japan.
Spread across three floors (58–60F), the observatory features sky lounges, cafés, and a museum for a complete elevated experience.
Conveniently located above Osaka Abenobashi Station — one of Osaka's most connected transport hubs — for effortless access.

Explore this stunning church at your own pace, or join one of the many guided tours upon arrival. Either way, a visit to the St. Paul's Cathedral is one monument you absolutely must visit when in London!
highlights: Explore Sir Christopher Wren’s masterpiece that has been a place of Christian worship for over 1400 years - St. Paul's Cathedral.
Gain access to the Cathedral and forget about waiting in lines.
Climb 530 steps up to the Golden Gallery to get unforgettable views of London.
Visit the Stone Gallery with its wide corridors and high stone walls and marvel at your surroundings through its gaps.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Children must be accompanied and supervised by an adult aged 18 or over when accessing the Dome Galleries. Child 6 to 17 yrs Multimedia guides are provided. Devices are thoroughly cleaned before and after each use. Headphones are provided on-site, but you are welcome to bring your own (3.5mm jack connection). Alternatively, you can download the free app to play on your own device. Respectful non-flash photography for personal use inside the Cathedral is welcomed outside service times. Filming, tripods, monopods and selfie sticks are not permitted. No bags or items larger than 45cm x 30cm x 25cm, including handles, wheels and pockets may be brought into the Cathedral. There is no cloakroom facility. Bags may be searched on entry. The wearing of face coverings is not mandatory, however, the Cathedral welcomes and encourages worshippers, visitors, staff and volunteers to continue to wear masks if they prefer. Please be mindful and respectful of the choices of others. Hand sanitizer is available at the entry point and throughout the Cathedral. There are no limits on party sizes but all visitors are asked to please be respectful of those who may wish to maintain social distancing.

globaltix_product_data.description: Head on over to Desaru Resort Waterpark with your family and friends, and prepare yourself for a splashingly good time! Explore the waterpark's five zones, each featuring different levels of rides. Explore a setting filled with intrigue, pirates, and young heroes at Penawar Falls. With the classic Swinging Ship and with multiple waterfalls tumbling over rising cliffs into a pond below, this zone is sure to capture the attention of both young and old alike. Ride along the long, looping, lazy Penawar River that floats amid the lush greenery of fishing village scenes and experience four giant water slides — the Wild Whirl, Super Twister, Riptide, and Temptest!
highlights: The park is set against the backdrop of a traditional Malaysian fishing village.
It is home to one of the world’s largest wave pools.
It features the first-ever water coaster in the region.
The park offers more than 20 wet and dry rides, slides, and attractions.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Discover the beauty of the Whitsunday Islands and snorkel the outer Great Barrier Reef on a fast jetboat day tour from Airlie Beach. Relax on Whitehaven Beach and admire views from Hill Inlet lookout.

highlights: Embark on a bushwalk to the Hill Inlet lookout
Snorkel at the outer Great Barrier Reef and discover a vibrant underwater world
Spot a variety of colourful fish and marine species at Bait Reef Lagoon

Ride at high speed across the waves on a specialized jet speedboat
inclusions: Guided snorkel tour on the Great Barrier Reef

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: All passengers must be 130cm tall to ride. No refunds will be issued in the event a passenger is found to be too short to ride less than 24 hours from departure. The bushwalk to Hill Inlet Lookout is graded moderate and consists of many stone steps. Comfortable shoes and a reasonable level of fitness are advised. Customers wishing to snorkel MUST BE ABLE TO SWIM. We can not teach you to swim. We snorkel 'wild' off the back of the boat, on the outer Great Barrier Reef, where there is no infrastructure. If you have never snorkelled before, or you are a weak/non-swimmer this may be too dangerous for you and we may not be able to allow you into the water. Captain's orders must be followed. This tour is NOT suitable for anyone with: mobility impairment, back/neck/spine issues, or those unable to walk unassisted. If you hesitated at any of these, please call us to discuss. If weather conditions are unfavorable, there may be an alternate route to ensure the safety of passengers and crew.

Experience Singapore’s southern coastline at your own pace with the Albatross Hop-On Hop-Off Speedboat Pass — a flexible 1-day pass that gives you unlimited rides,...
globaltix_product_data.description: Albatross Hop-On Hop-Off Speedboat Pass (1-Day Unlimited Speedboat Rides)Singapore’s first and only hop-on hop-off speedboat experience. Experience Singapore’s southern coastline at your own pace with the Albatross Hop-On Hop-Off Speedboat Pass — a flexible 1-day pass that gives you unlimited rides, total freedom, and the thrill of exploring Singapore’s stunning Southern Islands by sea.Cruising 23 kilometres of scenic southern waters, this pass allows you to hop on and off our fast adventure vessel throughout the day. Start from Resorts World Sentosa or Ola Beach Club at Siloso Beach, and continue your journey at our island hop-on points at Lazarus Island, Kusu Island, and Sisters’ Islands. Whether you’re chasing excitement or seeking a relaxing coastal escape, this flexible experience lets you customise your perfect adventure. Admire iconic landmarks such as Dragon’s Teeth Gate, Lazarus Island, St. John’s Island, Kusu Island, Sisters’ Islands, and the majestic Singapore City Skyline — all from the comfort of a high-speed boat accommodating up to 50 passengers. Learn more about the iconic Singapore landmarks and the Singapore Story from the engaging and informative audio commentary throughout the cruise.Complimentary raincoats and bottled water are available upon request, ensuring comfort throughout your journey.Boats operate on a continuous loop throughout the day — simply return to any hop-on point to rejoin the cruise at your convenience.Feel the sea breeze, ride the waves, and discover hidden gems across Singapore’s Southern Islands — all on your own schedule with the Albatross Hop-On Hop-Off Speedboat Pass. Visit Us Address: Albatross Ticket Booth - Address: 8 Sentosa Gateway, Singapore 098269 (Adjacent to Singapore Oceanarium) 46 Siloso Beach Walk, Sentosa Island, Singapore 099005 www.olabeachclub.com

Island stops: Lazarus, Kusu & Sisters’ Islands
Comfortable 50-passenger high-speed boat, Perfect for families, couples & adventurers
Boarding points: Resorts World Sentosa & Ola Beach Club (Siloso Beach)
Stunning views of Dragon’s Teeth Gate, southern coastline & Singapore skyline

Hop Off to Explore – Disembark at Ola Beach Club (Siloso Beach) to enjoy the beach and nearby attractions. Hop Back On Anytime – Rejoin the adventure as many times as you like throughout the day. End Your Journey – Return to Resorts World Sentosa or Ola Beach Club before the last sail. Life jackets provided for all guests. Bring sunscreen, sunglasses, and light clothing. This ticket gives you the flexibility to travel from your starting point to the destination, and then hop back onto the speedboat anytime within the operating hours to return to your original location. You can board our comfortable vessel from either Resorts World Sentosa or Ola Beach Club, experience a pleasant ride across the water, and return effortlessly when you are ready. It's the perfect option if you need efficient, guaranteed transport back and want to enjoy a quick, water-based viewing experience. This round-trip cruise along the Sentosa shore provides clear, unique views of the island's waterfront. globaltix_product_data.summary: Get a ticket to the Royal Alcázar of Seville, and marvel at this stunning medieval Islamic palace. Walk around and admire the stunning architecture and the beautiful gardens. Originally developed as a fort for the Cordoban governors of Seville in 913, the Royal Alcázar of Seville is an amazing fusio...
globaltix_product_data.description: Get a ticket to the Royal Alcázar of Seville, and marvel at this stunning medieval Islamic palace. Walk around and admire the stunning architecture and the beautiful gardens. Originally developed as a fort for the Cordoban governors of Seville in 913, the Royal Alcázar of Seville is an amazing fusion of Christian and Moorish architecture. It was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987, and it has been renovated numerous times over the 11 centuries since its creation. Learn about how the Christian king Fernando III moved into the Alcázar when he captured Seville in 1248 and how several monarchs used the palace as their main residence. Also, discover the Alcázar's role as a filming location for the Game of Thrones TV series.
highlights: Discover the location for the Game of Thrones TV series
Enjoy one of the most outstanding examples of Moorish architecture in Spain
Marvel at this unique fusion of Spanish Christian and Moorish architecture

globaltix_product_data.description: The Paris Aquarium (also known as Cinéaqua) is a world class festival of the sea. One of the oldest aquariums in the world - it was built in 1867 -, it has more than 10,000 creatures who call its depths home. Featuring mermaid shows, an aquatic cinema and a shark basin stacked with the apex predators, this is an incredible way to add a deep blue dimension to your trip to the center of Paris.The Paris Aquarium embodies the late-19th-century passion for scientific exploration. Every major city had to have an aquarium, and as Europe’s leading urban light, Paris's had to be the best. Decorated like it stepped out of Jules Verne's , this particular bowl of fishes is as rich with history as it is in aquatic life. 10,000 fish swim in 4 million liters of water, with tanks holding aquatic life from far-flung tropical locales, as well as from closer to home. In fact, the first section is full of carp, sturgeon and roach swimming in a re-creation of the nearby Seine.The recreated seas of Tahiti and New Caledonia swarm with fish of all colors: angel, clown and triggerfish jockey for position, as they dart among rock and coral. The scale is awe-inspiring; it’s not surprising that this was once Europe’s largest aquarium.The show stealers, however, are the sharks. Four species of these predators of the deep never fail to elicit squeals from the kids, and nervous laughter from everyone else. The aquarium also has two large screens that show aquatic documentaries, live feeding demonstrations, and a touchtank, where kids can get their hands on some slippery ornamental fish. At the end of your visit you'll emerge into one of the most beautiful parts of the city. Eiffel Tower at your elbow, the Champs-Élysées at your back, and the whole city at your fingertips. Off you go, there's more to explore.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Arc de Triomphe is a Neoclassical take on the ancient Roman triumphal arch style. Fifty meters tall, the view from the platform atop the arch is well worth the hike. See the dozen Parisian avenues radiating out from the arch into the City of Light. Paris is one of the most fascinating places in the world and you will find yourself right at its center. Inspired by the great arches of ancient Rome, Napoleon commissioned the Arc de Triomphe shortly after his victory at Austerlitz. Unfortunately, he never lived to see its completion. At the base of the arch, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier pays tribute to the 1.3 million French soldiers who died in World War I. Behold the eternal flame that is rekindled at 6.30 PM each evening. In addition, there is a must-see exhibition that explains the symbolic importance of this monument. The view from the top of the arch is worth climbing the 284 stairs. From your privileged position, survey all of Paris. Unlike the obligatory Eiffel Tower trip, getting into the Arc de Triomphe is an effort not all tourists undertake. Please note that the elevator is strictly for disabled people.

globaltix_product_data.description: More than 700 different species of animals call the ARTIS Zoo home. Well, none of them can actually talk, but they live here. And on your visit you'll get the chance to visit the penguins, wolves, giraffes and more. There's also an impressive art collection, a zoological library, a planetarium and 26 more historical buildings. It's a history-filled menagerie, in a quiet and quaint canal district - there's a little something for everyone at ARTIS.Elephants, penguins, giraffes, alligators and more are onsite here at Europe's oldest zoo. Walk through the leafy environment, among the beautiful buildings and soak up the atmosphere and animal sightings. Built in 1838, ARTIS has 27 monumental, historic buildings as part of its campus. (This historic significance is sadly lost on most of the residents).The whole experience is wonderfully wild, yet refined. There's art in its aquarium (alongside the sea creatures), an old-timey zoological library just behind the anteaters, and an excellent restaurant with a terrace overlooking the aviary. Yet another crowd pleaser is the Butterfly Garden – the only place you're likely to find a real life fluttering hairpiece, if one of the hundreds of butterflies lands on your head.

globaltix_product_data.description: The From Krakow: Auschwitz-Birkenau Guided Tour & Hotel Pickup is a full-day historical and educational experience that takes visitors from Krakow to the Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial and Museum, one of the most significant UNESCO World Heritage Sites in the world. This guided tour offers a deeply moving journey into history, providing insight into the Holocaust and the events of World War II through expert-led narration. Traveling in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle with optional hotel pickup, guests will reach the memorial site in Oświęcim, where a licensed historian guide leads a comprehensive tour of both Auschwitz I and Auschwitz II-Birkenau. Visitors will walk through original barracks, prison blocks, and memorial grounds, gaining a powerful understanding of the lives, suffering, and stories of those who were held there. The experience lasts approximately 7–10 hours and follows a fixed schedule with pre-booked entry tickets to ensure a smooth visit. Guests are picked up from their hotel or a central meeting point, transferred to the site, and guided through both camps (around 3.5 hours total), before returning to Krakow—making it a structured yet impactful day trip

globaltix_product_data.description: Immerse yourself in everything nautical, with a visit to the Australian National Maritime Museum! Learn the rich history of Australia in an enjoyable and fun way, with the help of many great exhibits, cool artefacts and plenty of hands on things to interact with! With so many interesting things to explore at the Museum, you are guaranteed to be occupied for hours! Jump aboard one of the famous vessels that regularly dock at the harbour and discover the ins and outs of these impressive ships, including yachts, tall ships, submarines and even navy vessels, check out the last Action Stations experience; an exciting new way to explore the compelling history of the Royal Australian Navy through thrilling cinematic experiences, and so much more! Perfect for visitors of all ages, the Australian National Maritime Museum hosts a number of exciting activities that are sure to keep the children entertained! Let the under-5's go wild in the Mini Mariners Play zone, or for the older ones, enjoy the hands on activities held in the Kids on Deck area! If you're after a great day out, whether you have a fascination for all things water or not, the Australian National Maritime Museum is the attraction you've been searching for! Note * Open from 1 December 2021 Inclusions * Australian National Maritime Museum one day entry * The immersive Action Stations experience * The latest blockbuster exhibitions * The fleet of historic vessels, including our submarine, destroyer and tall ship (when in port) * Permanent galleries * Under-5s play zone Mini Mariners Play * Hands-on activities in Kids on Deck Highlights * With the Big Ticket you'll have unlimited access to everything that's open at the museum on the day of your visit * HMB Endeavour - The acclaimed replica of Captain James Cook’s famous 18th-century tall ship * HMAS Vampire Daring Class Destroyer (1956) - Australia’s largest museum vessel and the last of the nation’s big-gun warships * HMAS Onslow Oberon Class Submarine (1969) - A decommissioned Royal Australian Navy submarine * Action Stations - Explore that danger and drama of Navy life at sea * Cape Bowling Green Lighthouse - Built in 1874, visitors can climb to the top for unparalleled views over Darling Harbour and Sydney * Six permanent galleries - Covering all aspects of Australia’s connection to the sea; from trade to defence and migration * Yearly exhibitions * Kids on Deck craft activities - Sundays or every day during the Australian school holidays Booking Information * Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking * Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of the tour * For your information, complete Tour Operator Information including contact details is included on your tour voucher

globaltix_product_data.description: Australia’s Outback Spectacular presents their new show ‘Heartland’. Come along and witness a heart warming and immersive arena show with a three course meal and beverages, incredible special effects, inspiring animal performances and a star studded cast. Set in the Australian Outback Spectacular’s iconic red barn, be transported to the outback with an all new arena show featuring a cast of talented Australian actors and the latest technology that depicts farm life during a severe drought. Follow the true story of farmers Reg and Marge who are struggling to keep their farm going after 5 years without rain. The story depicts the real struggles of Australian farmers and life in the outback as told through humour, quirky characters and friendship set to the soundtrack of popular Australian country music. Using the latest projection technology and with the help of some incredibly talented horses and their riders, see the arena transform into a variety of harsh outback landscapes that give the illusion of rugged plains, green fields, red dust, rocky outcrops, stampeding cattle, fire and rain. On the menu for the evening is a delicious three course meal featuring a Woodfired Vegetable and Goat Feta Tart for entree, a main meal of Eye Fillet Steak or Tender Chicken Breast and a Dark Chocolate Flan with Chocolate Ganache and salted caramel sauce for dessert. Complimentary beer, wine and soft drink is served throughout the show.

globaltix_product_data.description: Hop aboard a crystal-clear cable car at Awana Station and enjoy a scenic 10-minute gondola ride up to Genting Highlands. As you glide through the sky, take in breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding mountains, lush rainforest, and tall pagodas emerging from the greenery along the way. You can also stop at Chin Swee Station to visit the famous Chin Swee Caves Temple, a Taoist temple located in the Genting Highlands. Capture photos of iconic landmarks such as the 9-storey grand pagoda, the Sky Terrace, and the impressive 15-meter-tall Buddha statue. Upon arrival at Genting Highlands, explore a wide range of attractions, luxury hotels, shopping outlets, and exciting theme parks.
highlights: Fly up in just 10 minutes: The gondola lift system takes you from the Awana Station at mid-hill to the SkyAvenue Station at the peak.
Chin Swee Caves Temple: With the same ticket, you get a free stop at the Chin Swee Station, where you can explore the beautiful Chin Swee Caves Temple.
Offers stunning 360-degree views of surrounding rainforest.

options.name: Two Way (Awana SkyWay Standard Gondola)
options.description:
Enjoy flexibility with your purchase. Your ticket may be used at either Genting SkyWay or Awana SkyWay


Enjoy a scenic journey on a crystal-clear cable car from Awana Station to Genting Highlands. During the approximately 10-minute gondola ride, you can admire panoramic mountain views, lush rainforest landscapes, and traditional pagodas rising above the greenery as you ascend towards SkyAvenue Station.

Along the way, you may stop at Chin Swee Station to visit the famous Chin Swee Caves Temple, a Taoist temple located in the Genting Highlands. Take photos of notable landmarks including the 9-storey pagoda, Sky Terrace, and the 15-metre-tall Buddha statue. Once you arrive at Genting Highlands, you can explore various attractions, premium hotels, shopping experiences, and exciting theme parks.

Important Notice:

Kindly take note on the maintenance closure of Genting Highlands Premium Outlets Cable Car (Formerly known as Awana SkyWay).   

Genting Gohtong Jaya Cable Car (Formerly known as Genting SkyWay – Old Cable Car) will be operating from 0700 to 2300 hrs during the maintenance closure of Genting Highlands Premium Outlets Cable Car.

 

Genting Highlands Premium Outlets Cable Car (formally known as Awana SkyWay)

  • Date: 20 to 29 April 2026
  • Duration:10 (Ten) days
  • Purpose: 2026 – 2nd Quarterly Maintenance

Important Notes for Guests :

  • Guests may choose to board the Genting Gohtong Jaya Cable Car using the same QR code, as heavy congestion is expected at the Genting Highlands Premium Outlets station.
  • The Genting Gohtong Jaya Cable Car does not stop at Chin Swee Caves Temple.

Access Guidelines:

  • Guests not staying overnight are encouraged to use the Genting Gohtong Jaya Cable Car to access the Resort.

How to Get There

  • By bus: From KL Sentral, you can take the Genting Express Bus located at the Lower Ground Floor, which operates daily and travels directly to Awana Bus Terminal. From the terminal, head to Level 4 to board the cable car at Awana Station.
  • By car:From KLCC, it takes approximately 48 minutes’ drive to reach Awana Bus Terminal. From there, proceed to Level 4 of the building to board the cable car at the Genting Highlands Premium Outlets Cable Car Station.

globaltix_product_data.description: Walk around and spot with a thousand birds in Bali Bird Park, a habitat-like aviary. Drop by any of the seven regions that recreate the natural habitats of different birds, complete with the local plant life. Travel from the deep misty jungle of Sumatra all the way to Far East Indonesia and Papua and discover the native birds from these regions. Explore the South African Savannah and meet the Congo grey parrot. Venture to the South American region and see golden macaws and hyacinth macaws—the largest parrots in the world. Don't miss out on the bird shows happening all over the Bird Park! See storks and cockatoos at the Bali Rainforest Free Flight Bird Show, and marvel at eagles and falcons at Basic Instinct. Drop by Meet the Bird Stars to encounter some truly unique creatures.
highlights: The Bali Bird Park is home to a diverse collection of bird species from Indonesia and around the world.
Guests can enjoy interactive exhibits and up-close encounters with birds, allowing for a hands-on learning experience.
The park is set amidst lush tropical gardens, providing a picturesque backdrop for visitors to explore and relax.

globaltix_product_data.description: Get ready for a new family-friendly escape in the heart of Bedugul, Bali - Bali Farm House! Opening its doors on February 25th, 2024, this charming destination promises a delightful farm experience for all ages. At Bali Farm House, get up close and personal with friendly alpacas, explore the petting zoo, and visit the horse stables. Don't miss out on unique activities like picnicking in the farm, alpaca feeding, pony rides, and cuddling adorable baby animals in The Nursery.Beyond being a tourist hotspot, Bali Farm House is a haven for relaxation and nature appreciation. Indulge in coffee, croissants, and gelato at The Farm Pantry cafe, and savor delicious international cuisine at The Barn restaurant. With its scenic indoor and outdoor seating for up to 150 visitors, it's the perfect venue for events, buffets, and even pre-wedding photoshoots.
highlights: Bali Farm House offers a welcoming environment suitable for families, providing a memorable escape in the heart of Bedugul, Bali.
Guests can immerse themselves in a delightful farm experience, interacting with friendly alpacas, exploring the petting zoo, and visiting the horse stables.
Bali Farm House offers a variety of unique activities for visitors of all ages.

options.name: Standard Admission Ticket (Domestic) - Promo Group min 50 pax
options.description: Operating Hours Open Daily: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Central Indonesia Time/WITA) Recommended last entry: Around 4:00 PM to allow sufficient time to explore the park. For more information details, kindly click the link labeled "WeChat" Location Batubulan, Sukawati, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80582, Indonesia. Important Notes Smoking and vaping are prohibited throughout the park. Pets are not allowed inside the park. Do not feed, tease, disturb, trap, or attempt to touch animals unless supervised by staff. Help keep the park clean by disposing of rubbish properly. Visitors are responsible for their personal belongings. Follow all safety signage and staff instructions for a safe visit.
options.termsAndConditions: Ticket Eligibility The ticket is valid only on the visit date selected at the time of purchase. Entry on a different date is strictly not permitted under any circumstances. Child tickets must be purchased together with at least one adult ticket. Children are not permitted to enter the park without an accompanying adult at all times. Guests must present a valid ID card, Passport, or KITAS upon arrival at the park entrance. Failure to present valid identification may result in entry being refused. This attraction is suitable for most travellers. It is not recommended for guests with back problems or conditions that may be aggravated by walking on uneven terrain. The park is wheelchair accessible and stroller accessible. Guests with accessibility requirements are welcome and may explore the park with ease throughout their visit. Attraction Access Admission grants access to all standard reptile exhibits and public zones within Bali Reptile Park on the selected visit date during operating hours. A minimum of 2 complimentary zoo guide sessions are included with admission, providing guests with guided introductions to selected reptile species and exhibits. While zoo guide services are provided, the supervision and safety of children remain the full responsibility of parents or accompanying adults throughout the entire visit. Re-entry is strictly not permitted after leaving the park. Guests who exit the venue during their visit will not be allowed to re-enter on the same ticket. Park management reserves the right to restrict access to any exhibit or zone at any time for animal welfare, safety, or maintenance reasons without prior notice. Additional Information Outside food and beverages are strictly not permitted inside Bali Reptile Park. Guests are advised to purchase refreshments at the on-site outlets available within the park. Guests are reminded not to tap on enclosure glass, feed animals outside designated zones, or engage in any behaviour that may disturb or stress the reptiles on display. Personal photography for non-commercial use is welcome throughout the park. Flash photography near reptiles and animals is strongly discouraged at all exhibit areas. Guests are advised to wear comfortable clothing and closed-toe footwear suitable for walking across the park's pathways and exhibit areas throughout the visit. The park is not responsible for any lost, stolen, or damaged personal belongings during the visit. Guests are advised to secure all valuables before entering the park. Important Notes All ticket sales are final. Tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable once purchased, except in cases of park closure due to extraordinary circumstances. Re-entry after leaving the park is strictly prohibited. Guests must plan their visit accordingly and ensure they have completed all intended activities before exiting. Park management reserves the right to refuse entry to guests who do not comply with park rules, behave disruptively, or pose a risk to animal or visitor safety. Operating hours and animal exhibit availability are subject to change without prior notice, particularly during public holidays or special events at the park. The park management accepts no liability for personal injury, loss, or damage sustained during a visit to Bali Reptile Park or within its premises at any time. How to Get There Bali Reptile Park is located in Bali, Indonesia. Guests are advised to search the official park name on Google Maps for the most current and accurate location details. By rideshare: Gojek and Grab are widely available across Bali. Enter the park name into the app for direct routing from your hotel or any point across the island. By private driver: Hotel-arranged private drivers are widely available and are a convenient option for families and groups visiting the park on the day of their visit. Paid parking is available at the park for guests arriving by private vehicle or motorcycle. Guests are advised to arrive early during peak holiday and weekend periods. Guests must present their valid ID card, Passport, or KITAS at the park entrance. Please ensure the correct identification document is accessible before arriving.

globaltix_product_data.description: At the Bali Zoo Park, you're encouraged to get "Zoological" with wildlife - to see animals in their own habitat and to get to know them personally.Home to more than 350 animals, the zoo is situated in the very heart of Bali and offers an amazing educational experience into Bali's stunning nature. Choose between a regular visit, a day time "explorer" tour with animal feeding, transfers and lunch, or find out what the animals are up to after sundown with a night time Bali zoo tour including dinner and transfers. With lots to see, do and discover, Bali Zoo Tour is a great activity for the whole family. Not only will you get to see the Bengal tiger, African lion, and bears up close, but you and the little ones will also get to pet deer, play with rabbits, get hands-on with snakes and baby crocodiles. Combine that with exotic bird shows, pony rides, and playing with elephants and there's something for everyone in the family.
highlights: The zoo features beautifully landscaped exhibits that mimic the natural habitats of the animals, providing both entertainment and enrichment for visitors.
Guests can learn about the behaviors, habitats, and conservation efforts related to the zoo's resident animals.

globaltix_product_data.description: Visit the popular, family-run Ballarat Wildlife Park in Victoria and get up close with a wide variety of native Aussie and exotic animals. There are few friendlier or more personal wildlife attractions in Australia than this facility where you can come face-to-face with a wide assortment of creatures including kangaroos, koalas, wombats, crocodiles and more all located in pleasant, green surroundings. A wonderful place to visit for families or for first-time visitors to Australia, with tickets to Ballarat Wildlife Park you'll get a true Aussie adventure that incorporates a range of live shows where you'll gain further insight into various species. The various shows will let you learn about different kinds of snakes, pat a koala, get up close with friendly wombats, see birds of prey in flight and much more. The park is open daily from 9am until 5pm with the exception of Christmas Day. One of Victoria's must-visit animal attractions just a short drive from the centre of Ballarat, grab your tickets to Ballarat Wildlife Park online today.

globaltix_product_data.name: Grand Palace, Wat Pho & Golden Mount City Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: This is the Bangkok you came for: real canal life, great city views, and the royal landmarks everyone wants to see. Join Discova’s freshly upgraded classic Bangkok experience as you move from the canals to one of the city’s best viewpoints at the Golden Mount, and then on to the Grand Palace and Wat...
globaltix_product_data.description: This is the Bangkok you came for: real canal life, great city views, and the royal landmarks everyone wants to see. Join Discova’s freshly upgraded classic Bangkok experience as you move from the canals to one of the city’s best viewpoints at the Golden Mount, and then on to the Grand Palace and Wat Pho, completing a route that brings Bangkok’s most iconic areas together in one perfect experience. Meet your guide at Hua Chang Pier (BTS Ratchathewi) for a quick welcome and hop on a public boat and glide along Saen Saep, passing through local Muslim communities around the Jim Thompson house that have lived along the canal for generations. Then, step off near the edge of the Old Town and walk into a different Bangkok. Along the way, we’ll pass near sections tied to the original town walls and a small white fort, and if you’re lucky you might even spot a monitor lizard cruising the water at a canal crossroads. Then it’s time for one of the best views in the city: Wat Saket, the Golden Mount. Climb the winding steps, ring the bells, and watch the skyline open up in every direction! Your guide keeps it light but meaningful: a simple introduction to Buddhist symbols you’ll see throughout the day, and why this hilltop temple is known as the “Golden Mountain.” From here, jump into a classic tuk-tuk ride and head straight to Bangkok’s royal heart: arriving at the Grand Palace, your licensed guide leads you through the most important sections of Thailand’s former royal residence, including visiting the revered Emerald Buddha, Thailand’s most sacred image. By the end of the visit, you will understand why such a small image holds such deep importance in Thai culture. After exploring the palace, continue on foot to nearby Wat Pho, one of Bangkok’s oldest and most significant temple complexes. Visit the hall of the Reclining Buddha, then continue through courtyards lined with chedis and murals as your guide leads you beyond the main statue to explore the wider temple grounds and understand why Wat Pho holds such an important place in Thai Buddhist tradition. Your tour ends at Wat Pho, but this part of Bangkok is perfect to keep exploring on your own. You can stay in the area for a relaxed lunch at a riverside café with views of Wat Arun, or simply hop on the quick ferry across the river if you’d like to visit it. From here, you’re in one of the most walkable and atmospheric corners of the Old Town!
highlights: Take in sweeping Old Town views from the top of the Golden Mount
Drift through Bangkok’s canals, ride a tuk-tuk, and explore on foot
Step inside the Grand Palace and feel Thailand’s royal heritage
See the Emerald Buddha and hear the stories behind its importance
Wander Wat Pho’s courtyards and meet the iconic Reclining Buddha
inclusions: Public Transportation Fee during the tour

globaltix_product_data.description: With this comprehensive bus tour you can hop on the bus, see some sights from your comfy seat, and then hop off at any stop you'd like to get to know better. When you're ready, hop back on the next bus, and continue to get to know the Catalan capital. With three routes you can plan to cover practically the whole city - and in summer, this can also be your beach transport! Choose a 1 or 2-day ticket and enjoy some of the most varied sight-seeing of your holiday!Whether you're visiting Barcelona for a week or a few days, with the hop-on hop-off bus you can maximize your time in the Catalan capital. The Blue Route takes you through all the essential must-sees, such as the towering and the magical . And of course, for football fans ... CAMP NOU! The stadium is quite far out of the center, so combine a visit there with other highlights along the way. The Red Route is the most central one. It covers romantic spots in Parc de la Ciutadella, the bustle of Passeig de Gracia, as well as panoramic views from the highest mountain in Barcelona: Montjuïc. This varied route will have you hopping off and on again to get the most out of Barcelona's vibrant city rhythms. If there's still time on your agenda, you should take the beach break you deserve. The Green Route (summer only) takes you out and around Barcelona's lengthy stretches of sand and sun. Mingle with the locals at the popular , or let the sand slip through your toes at and . BTW: nude sunbathing is allowed here, so if you see naked people, that's why. If you prefer to be swimsuited that's fine. This is Catalonia: no judgements, just the good life.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Guided Tour to Sagrada Família and Park Güell combines Barcelona's two most celebrated and architecturally extraordinary creations of Antoni Gaudí in a single expertly managed day that delivers the full scope of the visionary Catalan architect's unique and unprecedented contribution to world arc...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Guided Tour to Sagrada Família and Park Güell combines Barcelona's two most celebrated and architecturally extraordinary creations of Antoni Gaudí in a single expertly managed day that delivers the full scope of the visionary Catalan architect's unique and unprecedented contribution to world architecture. Both sites are UNESCO World Heritage properties — the Sagrada Família basilica representing Gaudí's spiritual and architectural masterpiece in its most ambitious and monumental form, and Park Güell the most playful, colourful, and nature-inspired expression of his decorative genius in a garden and public space of extraordinary originality. The expert Amigo Tours guide provides the biographical and architectural context that makes both sites fully comprehensible and deeply rewarding — covering Gaudí's creative philosophy, his synthesis of natural forms and Gothic structural principles, his deeply personal Catholic faith, and the specific design decisions at both sites that reflect the full depth of his architectural vision. All tickets are pre-secured by Amigo Tours for both attractions — eliminating the significant challenge of independent procurement for two of Barcelona's most popular and strictly capacity-controlled sites and ensuring a seamlessly structured and genuinely enriching full Gaudí day in the Catalan capital.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Experience the magic of Barcelona at night! ✨ Departing from the heart of the city, Plaça de Catalunya, this unforgettable route takes you past some of the most iconic landmarks in the Catalan capital. globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the magic of Barcelona at night! ✨ Departing from the heart of the city, Plaça de Catalunya, this unforgettable route takes you past some of the most iconic landmarks in the Catalan capital. As the sun goes down, Barcelona lights up and reveals a unique, elegant and captivating atmosphere, perfect for discovering the city from a different perspective. During this Barcelona Night Tour, you’ll admire the impressive Plaça d’Espanya, the charming Poble Espanyol and the views around the Olympic Ring. You’ll also pass through Barcelona’s Port and the Columbus Monument, continue along the Arc de Triomf and take in the futuristic Torre Glòries. The route also includes the beautiful Sant Pau Art Nouveau Site and the majestic Sagrada Família, before bringing you closer to two of Gaudí’s most famous masterpieces: La Pedrera and Casa Batlló. If you’re looking for things to do in Barcelona at night, this panoramic experience is a comfortable, visual and memorable way to discover some of the city’s must-see spots. From the upper deck of the bus, you’ll enjoy 360-degree views, perfect for taking spectacular photos of Barcelona at night and experiencing a route that combines culture, architecture and the charm of the city after dark. globaltix_product_data.summary: Experience endless fun and excitement at Berjaya Times Square Theme Park, a world-class indoor amusement park located within one of Kuala Lumpur’s largest shopping malls. Enjoy adrenaline-pumping rides like the Supersonic Odyssey suspended roller coaster and thrilling Go-Kart racing, alongside famil...
globaltix_product_data.description: Experience endless fun and excitement at Berjaya Times Square Theme Park, a world-class indoor amusement park located within one of Kuala Lumpur’s largest shopping malls. Enjoy adrenaline-pumping rides like the Supersonic Odyssey suspended roller coaster and thrilling Go-Kart racing, alongside family-friendly attractions in the Kids’ Zone with colorful rides and safe play areas. The Experience Pass offers unlimited access to rides and attractions, plus entertainment in the arcade filled with games for all ages. With flexible single- or multi-day passes, dining options, and shopping just steps away, it’s the perfect destination for thrill-seekers, families, and friends looking for an action-packed day indoors.
highlights: Experience heart-pounding excitement with a variety of thrilling rides at Berjaya Times Square Theme Park.
Challenge your friends and family to a thrilling race on our exhilarating Go-Kart track, where speed and skill will determine the victor.
For the younger ones, the Kids' Zone offers a magical and enchanting experience.
Step into our Arcade section and discover a world of entertainment and gaming.
inclusions: Rides included: Supersonic Odyssey Roller Coaster, Robo Crash, Honey Bump, Molly-Cool’s Swing, Crazy Bus, Botanic Drive, Flying Bumble Bee, Buddy Go Round, Fantasy Trail, Dizzy Izzy, Spinning Orbit, Ooorts’ Express
Admission to: Berjaya Times Square Theme Park & Amusement Rides
exclusions: Excludes Terry Carnival Games Level 5, Terry Carnival Games Level 7, Haunted House, Semico Battle, Winter Wonderland Snow Town, 7D Xperia, Combat Heroes, Arcade Games and Go-Kart @ BTSKL.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Ticket is valid for Malaysian and non-Malaysian tourists. Ticket is valid for one-time entry only. A valid ticket must be presented to gain admission. Entry is only permitted within the validity period stated on the ticket. Entry will not be allowed for tickets that are invalid, redeemed, collected, consumed, lost, or expired. Tickets will not be replaced and no refund will be provided. The attraction reserves the right to request personal identification or proof of nationality before granting admission. Access may be denied if ticket conditions of sale have not been met. Eligibility Child below 3 years old or below 90 cm in height is free of charge. A surcharge of RM 20.00 (Adult) or RM 16.00 (Child) will be imposed on customers who fail to present their Malaysian Identity Card (MyKad/MyKid) during redemption of Malaysian ticket category. The attraction reserves the right to determine Child, Infant, Youth, Senior, or Adult ticket age range and may request proof of age before admission. Attraction Access Height, weight, size, and age restrictions and medical warnings apply to certain rides and attractions. These are displayed at each ride and available at Guest Services. The attraction reserves the right to change operating days, hours, and last admission times without prior notice. The attraction may temporarily or permanently close rides, events, or facilities for maintenance, safety, operational reasons, force majeure, special events, or private functions. No ticket replacement or refund will be granted under these circumstances. Additional Information No jewelry or valuable items are allowed to be worn or brought during activities. This activity is not recommended for individuals with medical conditions (e.g., high blood pressure, epilepsy), pregnant women, or seniors. Due to the nature of the activity, it is not recommended for persons with impaired physical mobility or wheelchair users. Important Notes Please ensure all admission, eligibility, and attraction access requirements above are reviewed prior to your visit. Plan your visit in advance and check the official website for the latest operating hours before arrival. How to Get There Easily accessible by public transportation. Take the KL Monorail to Imbi station, which is directly connected to Berjaya Times Square.
globaltix_product_data.address: Berjaya Times Square, 5th and 7th Floor, 1, Jln Imbi, Bukit Bintang

options.termsAndConditions:
Jurassic World: The Experience

Ticket Terms and Conditions for Jurassic World: The Experience

By purchasing this ticket and/or attending the Jurassic World: The Experience (""Experience""), you agree to the following terms and conditions:

 

1. Tickets

1.1 Access is valid based on your ticket type:

 

  • 1.1.1 Off Peak – Off Peak ticket holder is permitted to gain admission only during designated Off Peak days. Please refer to the official schedule (“Official Schedule”) as defined by ASSET WORLD ATTRACTION AND RETAIL CO.,LTD. and NEON Group of companies (the ""Experience Promoter"").
  • 1.1.2 Peak – Peak ticket holder has the flexibility to gain admission during designated anytime of Peak and Off Peak (After 4pm) days. Please refer to the Official Schedule

1.2. Tickets allow for ONE single entry only as the experience is a one-way journey, and guests will not be allowed to re-enter the Experience.

1.3 You are required to book a timeslot in advance so that you can enter the Experience venue at your preferred timing. Otherwise, you might be asked to return for a later timing if the Experience is operating at maximum capacity.

1.4 Ticket is valid for (Age is calculated according to date of birth):

 

  • 1.4.1 Adult: aged from 11 years and above.
  • 1.4.2 Child: aged between 3 - 10 years. Children age below eighteen (18) years old must be accompanied by at least one adult age over 18 years old. The accompanying adult/ guardian acknowledges and agrees to these ticket and admission terms and conditions.
  • 1.4.3 Child under three (3) years old is free of charge.

1.5. The operating hours of the Experience may change without prior notice. Guests are encouraged to visit the Jurassic World: The Experience – Bangkok website for updates before planning their visit.

1.6 Lost Tickets or damage ticket(s) will not be replaced or refunded.

 

General

 

1.7 Tickets shall not be used for giveaway or promotional purposes, unless approved in writing by the Experience Promoter.

1.8 Please be careful of your safety and belongings at all times. To the extent permitted by law, the Experience Promoter, its partners, vendors, officers and employees, shall not be liable for any damage, injury, illness, loss, cost and/or expense that you may suffer or incur as a result of your attendance at the Experience and/or utilization of the ticket or voucher.

1.9 The Experience venue and premises are under CCTV surveillance for safety and security.

1.10 You consent to the filming or recording and use of your image, photograph, video and/or other recording by the Experience Promoter or its appointed vendor for marketing and promotional purposes.

1.11 The Experience Promoter reserves the right to remove guests with unruly or disruptive behavior, from the Experience venue.

1.12 Any personal data collected by the Experience Promoter, its partners or vendors at the Experience shall be in accordance with the Experience Promoter's Privacy Policy (available on the Jurassic World: The Experience – Bangkok website)

1.13 Strictly no outside food or beverages are permitted on the Experience venue.

1.14 Prohibited Items The following items are not allowed within the exhibit:

 

  • Items that may pose a risk to visitors or dinosaurs such as long sticks, knives, selfie sticks, tripods, etc.
  • Smoking or vaping
  • Pets
  • Food or beverages (except for water for children)

1.15 Health Warning - This experience includes flashing lights, fog, loud noises, and realistic moving robotic dinosaurs, which may not be suitable for individuals with health conditions such as epilepsy or heart problems. Please use discretion when attending.

1.16 Guests under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or any intoxicants are not permitted to enter the venue.

1.17 Do not touch any dinosaurs unless instructed by staff. The dinosaurs in the exhibit are mechanical devices that may pose a risk. Guests will have a special opportunity to touch and interact with the baby dinosaurs under staff supervision.

1.18 All staff will communicate in English or Thai only

1.19 The Experience Promoter reserves the right to amend or add to these Terms & Conditions at any time without prior notice. Please refer to Jurassic World: The Experience – Bangkok website for updates.

1.20 Age shall be calculated on the visit date, each guest shall show his/her identification card for Thai people or show his/her passport for foreigners.

 

Better World Better Future

By purchasing the ticket and attending Better World Better Future, guests agree to the following terms and conditions:

 

 

  • Operating Hours: from 11:00 AM to 09:00 PM, and subject to change depending on the discretion of Asset World Attraction and Retail Company Limited (“AARC”).
  • Validity: Tickets are valid for a single admission on the specified date and time only. 
  • Cancellation Policy: Tickets are non-refundable. 

 

1. Tickets are valid for a single admission only.

2. Guests must book a timeslot in advance and may participate only on the specific date and time indicated on the ticket.

3. Children under 3 years old are not allowed to participate in this activity. Children aged 3 years and above will be charged the same rate as adults.

4. Guests with certain medical conditions, including those with heart or cardiovascular issues, neck, back, or spinal problems, high blood pressure, asthma or respiratory concerns, motion sickness, vertigo, panic disorder, pregnancy, or recent surgery, injury, or mobility limitation preventing proper restraint use are not permitted.

5. For safety reasons, who cannot be properly secured by the safety belt will not be allowed to participate in the 4D room.

6. Lost or damaged tickets will not be replaced or refunded.

7. Terms and conditions as well as operating hours are subject to change without prior notice.

8. In the event of any dispute, the decision of Asset World Attraction and Retail Company Limited (“AARC”) shall be final.

globaltix_product_data.description: Disclaimer- Routes are subject to change. Kindly download the Big Bus Tours App for latest routes, live bus tracking and more. Enjoy a 24 / 48-hour hop-on, hop-off sightseeing bus tour of Berlin. See all the famous sights including the Brandenburg Gate, Checkpoint Charlie and the Reichstag Building from the top deck of our open-top double-decker buses. Explore the city on foot on a live-guided walking tour.
highlights: Discover Berlin on foot with both a guided walking tour and digital self-guided walking tour
Explore Berlin on a hop-on, hop-off sightseeing tour by open-top, double-decker bus
Hop off at any stop to explore the world-class museums such as the Museum Island
Discover Berlin's tumultuous history with insightful audio commentary in 14 languages
See unmissable sights including the Reichstag Building, Brandenburg Gate, and Holocaust Memorial
inclusions: Unlimited Access to Hop-On Hop-Off throughout ticket validity
Live-Guided Walking Tour in English or German

Explore Darwin with complete flexibility on a 24 hour ticket, 48 hour ticket...
globaltix_product_data.description: Discover the Top End of Australia with a Darwin Hop On Hop Off bus pass. Travel to Darwin’s best attractions on one easy and convenient bus with 2 different routes operating throughout the city in the morning or afternoon! Explore Darwin with complete flexibility on a 24 hour ticket, 48 hour ticket or 48 hour deluxe ticket that includes an additional ticket to Crocosaurus Cove and The Royal Flying Doctor Service Museum. Not only is this a fantastic way to learn about a new city and its culture but a easy and convenient way to get around out of the tropical heat. The tours takes in popular landmarks such as the Art Gallery of Northern Territory, Military Museum, Mindil Beach, Crocosaurus Cove and more! With a bus pass you are free to jump on and off as you wish. Hop On Hop Off buses are the perfect way to discover a new city. Get your Darwin Hop On Hop Off bus tickets today! Note __Please note Big Bus Darwin is currently operating on the following days:__ * April - Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday * May - September, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday * October & November- Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday * December & January - globaltix_product_data.description: Double-up on the fun during your stay in Paris with tickets for a hop-on hop-off bus tour through the City of Lights, plus a bonus cruise along the Seine. Enjoy Paris from the open-air bus to discover the breathtaking heights of the Eiffel Tower, the historic grounds of the Louvre, the impressive Arc de Triomphe and much more. With multiple convenient stops throughout the city, you can get from one attraction to another easily. Then, experience the beautiful avenues, stunning architecture, and picturesque views on a cruise along the Seine for a unique view of Paris from the water. Audio guide: Arabic, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Spanish Meeting point: 11 Avenue de l'Opéra, 75001, Paris

Hop-on or hop-off at your leisure to create your own customized journey around the French capital

globaltix_product_data.summary: There's so much to see in the Eternal City, and this tour puts you in the passenger seat, so you can see all of the highlights - including the Colosseum, Pantheon, and St. Peter’s Basilica. You'll love the convenience of the air-conditioned hop-on, hop-off bus tour - so you have the luxury of decidi...
globaltix_product_data.description: There's so much to see in the Eternal City, and this tour puts you in the passenger seat, so you can see all of the highlights - including the Colosseum, Pantheon, and St. Peter’s Basilica. You'll love the convenience of the air-conditioned hop-on, hop-off bus tour - so you have the luxury of deciding how much time you want to spend at each individual location. Plus, by removing the stress of trying to conquer the city's public transport, you'll have more energy to explore your favorite sites.Rome has so many stunning sites that it can be hard to manage them all. But this hop-on hop-off tour takes you everywhere you want to go. Plus, the audio guide (available in nine languages) will give you plenty of context so you'll increase your understanding and appreciation of Rome's marvels. There's also a walking tour included, so you get to see some of Baroque Rome's finest sights.You’ll find out all about the emperors and the baying crowds who made the Colosseum such a unique, thrilling, and terrifying place in ancient times. Then you can hop off and visit the building itself. After exploring this mighty ruin at your own pace, you can hop right back on your Big Bus coach, and it's on to the next stop!Other stops include the nearby Circus Maximus - where 250,000 people would gather to watch the high-speed chariot races, and the historical center, with famous monuments such as the Trevi Fountain, the Spanish Steps, and the wondrous Pantheon. If you’ve still got energy – or even better, an extra day or two – Big Bus will also take you across the Tiber to visit the Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter’s Basilica.The old saying goes that "Rome wasn’t built in a day". You’ll quickly discover that Rome in a day is also a tall order. But with Big Bus Tours, you’ll see and learn much more than you ever thought was possible.

globaltix_product_data.description: Step into the wilderness at Malaga's Bioparc Fuengirola. This thoroughly modern zoo uses 'invisible' barriers to separate the animals from visitors. There are four different habitats with more than 200 rare species. And you, you'll be here too, safely wandering among the monkeys, gorillas, giant tortoises, white tigers, and leopards.Get out your expedition vest and pith helmet, it's adventure time! As you wander through Bioparc Fuengirola's four immersive zones you'll feel as if you're in Equatorial Africa, Madagascar Island, Southeast Asia, and the Indo-Pacific, respectively. This 'immersion zoo' park uses invisible barriers to keep visitors and animals separated so you'll feel right inside the habitats - though you're completely safe. You'll see hippopotamuses in Africa, cheeky lemurs in Madagascar, orangutans in Southeast Asia and a Komodo dragon in the Indo-Pacific zone. Plus 100s more furry and feathered creatures.This sustainable park promotes the conservation of animals, plants, and tropical forests, so you can feel extra-good about supporting Bioparc Fuengirola.Enjoy an animal-packed day with heart, and with zero danger of getting lost in the jungle for months.

globaltix_product_data.description: When was the last time you had a really good look at yourself? Amsterdam's own BODY WORLDS peels back the layers to offer a fascinating glimpse into the inner workings of real human bodies. And it goes a step further, asking the most important question of all – what makes us happy?Gunther von Hagens' incredible plastination processes have revolutionized the ways in which we understand the human body, allowing them to be preserved, dissected and displayed like never before. Now you can see a naked skeleton taking an afternoon stroll, or stare at the uncovered human nervous system floating in space like an eerie web.But there's more to BODY WORLDS than some scientific rubbernecking. The permanent exhibition goes in-depth (literally!) to look at what makes us happy, and how happiness affects our physical and mental health. It's a science lesson with a twist, mixing philosophy and physiology to spectacularly entertaining effect.With over 200 perfectly preserved and cleverly dissected bodies, BODY WORLDS is a thrillingly visceral journey through human anatomy, right in the heart of Amsterdam!

globaltix_product_data.summary: A visit to The House of Bols, The Cocktail & Genever Experience on Museum Square in Amsterdam, is a unique adventure and an unforgettable interactive experience of the glamorous world of cocktails, liqueurs, bartending and the Dutch spirit Genever. globaltix_product_data.description: A visit to The House of Bols, The Cocktail & Genever Experience on Museum Square in Amsterdam, is a unique adventure and an unforgettable interactive experience of the glamorous world of cocktails, liqueurs, bartending and the Dutch spirit Genever. At the House of Bols you will find out everything about Lucas Bols – the world’s oldest distilled spirit brand, which has been making liqueurs in Amsterdam since 1575! You will also discover Bols Genever – Holland’s rediscovered cocktail spirit.House of Bols takes you on a spectacular journey through flavours, aromas, images, sound and film. The tour incorporates the Hall of Taste, where you will discover all 38 Bols liqueurs and how they are made, the Delfts blue room, the World of Cocktails ‘club’ and the mysterious Bols Genever Room.The tour ends at the revolutionary Mirror Bar, where bartenders mix your preferred Bols Genever and craft a beautiful cocktail before your very eyes. Or maybe test your mixology skills by preparing your own drink! Those who wish to learn the art of flair bartending (think Tom Cruise in ‘Cocktail’) can do so in the magical Flair Booth with the specially designed Bols flair bottles. Cocktail enthusiasts can also shop till they drop in the Bols Shop or enjoy a second Bols cocktail for just € 6,50.As winner of the Dutch Design Award for Best Exhibition and Experience, House of Bols is proving that heritage and history mix perfectly with innovation and contemporary design.House of Bols is located in the famous Museum Quarter of Amsterdam, right across from the Van Gogh Museum and next to the Rijksmuseum.

globaltix_product_data.description: For an entirely different - yet equally impressive - perspective on the city of Brisbane, the **Brisbane Story Bridge Night Climb** option is a great choice as the city skyline and its twinkling lights provide a wonderfully illuminated backdrop to make the climb. Join the rest of your fellow climbers and suit up for an adventure that lasts for approximately 2 hours as your guides provide you first with all the necessary safety equipment and briefing followed by an enjoyable hike up one of Brisbane's most recognisable landmarks. As the night lights of the buildings twinkle in the distance, take in both the scenery and the detailed commentary from your friendly climb masters as they explain the history and highlights of both the bridge and the city of Brisbane as a whole, and bask in the feeling of achievement as you reach the top! The night climb option is ideal for those who appreciate a great night view or who may have done the climb before during the daylight.
highlights: Be amazed during your climb with factual commentary on Brisbane, including its history and heritage, and be rewarded by the breathtaking views from the top

globaltix_product_data.description: All our tours will start with a meet and greet by Mega Water Sports personnel at the arrival point and proceed to the Operations Beach Cabin located at Pantai Cenang, for the pre tour preparations. A safety briefing and jet ski operating procedure training will be provided by your assigned jet ski instructor guides. During this time, you will be required to pay careful attention to all instructions and safety procedures as Mega Water Sports adheres to strict safety rules. Participants will be assigned to their respective SeaDoo jet ski, assisted by our Water Attendants; follow their cue, before you proceed to gather with your group and your JetSki Instructor Guide. Tour commences. Fun and thrilling 2 hours island hopping tour customised for those seeking a short Jetski excursion to the islands not far away from the main Langkawi island. Watch some eagles at Singa Besar Island, stop by the famous beach island, Beras Basah and swim at a secluded island known as Intan Kecil island. Also great for those pressed for time but would not want to miss out on a jet ski island adventure! Your tour guide will not only take care of your safety but they will provide commentaries of nature aspects and interesting legendary storytellings.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Spend the day exploring the world above and below the water with a visit to the state of the art Cairns Aquarium. This must-visit Cairns attraction is full of fun and adventure for all ages to enjoy, Cairns Aquarium will give you a look into the animals that live in both the rainforests and the ocea...
globaltix_product_data.description: Spend the day exploring the world above and below the water with a visit to the state of the art Cairns Aquarium. This must-visit Cairns attraction is full of fun and adventure for all ages to enjoy, Cairns Aquarium will give you a look into the animals that live in both the rainforests and the oceans of Far North Queensland. With a visit here, you'll follow the journey of a drop of rain as it begins an adventure into our rivers and streams, our luscious rainforests, and of course, the beautiful Great Barrier Reef. With an emphasis on life underwater in Tropical North Queensland, there are ten different eco-systems showcasing a range of flora and fauna spread across 72 different habitats. With a number of different presentations throughout the day, including talks on River Monsters, the Ribbon Reef, the Open Ocean and Coral Sea Predators, you'll have a busy and fun day at the aquarium. There are also various Habitat Talks, animal feeding sessions and terrestrial and marine touch tanks that the kids will love. Home to over 16,000 aquatic animals, this is one of Queensland's biggest and best aquariums.
highlights: Over 16,000 aquatic animals
Touch Tanks with sea stars, sea cucumbers & others
11 amazing ecosystems to explore
Located in the heart of Cairns
Discover over 72 different habitats
