globaltix_product_data.name: Cebu Safari and Adventure Park
globaltix_product_data.summary: Cebu Safari and Adventure Park is the Philippines' largest and most comprehensively developed wildlife safari and adventure destination, a spectacular nature and leisure complex set across 170 hectares of scenic mountain terrain in Carmen, northern Cebu, that combines an extraordinary collection of...
globaltix_product_data.description: Cebu Safari and Adventure Park is the Philippines' largest and most comprehensively developed wildlife safari and adventure destination, a spectacular nature and leisure complex set across 170 hectares of scenic mountain terrain in Carmen, northern Cebu, that combines an extraordinary collection of over 200 animal species from across the globe with a thrilling range of adventure activities, cultural experiences, and family entertainment in a single magnificently situated park that offers some of the most breathtaking panoramic views across the Cebu mountain landscape and the surrounding Philippine islands available from any publicly accessible destination in the province. Home to Africa's Big Five alongside an extraordinary diversity of exotic wildlife from five continents, Cebu Safari delivers a genuine safari park experience of international standard in the heart of the Philippines, a destination of remarkable breadth, natural beauty, and sustained visitor engagement that consistently exceeds the expectations of first time visitors. The park's wildlife collection encompasses African lions, giraffes, zebras, white rhinos, and hippos alongside tigers, orangutans, Komodo dragons, crocodiles, exotic bird species, and an extraordinary range of reptiles, primates, and marine life housed in thoughtfully designed and naturalistic enclosures across the park's vast and beautifully maintained grounds. Beyond the wildlife encounters, Cebu Safari's adventure zone delivers an equally comprehensive programme of outdoor activities, including ziplines, wall climbing, ATV rides, horseback riding, and a range of other adrenaline charged outdoor pursuits set within the park's dramatic mountain landscape. The Zoobic Safari experience, the African Safari open vehicle tour, and the dedicated children's areas provide additional dimensions of family friendly engagement that make Cebu Safari one of the most complete and rewarding full day leisure destinations available to any visitor in the central Visayas region of the Philippines.
highlights: Drive through an African safari and see lions, giraffes, zebras, rhinos, and hippos.
Meet tigers, orangutans, Komodo dragons, crocodiles, and more exotic wildlife.
Enjoy exciting adventures including ziplines, ATV rides, wall climbing, and horseback riding.
Take in breathtaking views of the Cebu mountains and surrounding islands.
inclusions: Vary depending on the selected ticket option

globaltix_product_data.name: Chiang Mai Night Bike Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: Discover the charms of Old City Chiang Mai with 14 kilometers. Biking the back lanes and alleys experience the modern city alongside the ancient temples inside the walls of the old city. Begin your laid-back evening bike tour at 6.00 PM by heading towards the old city wall’s eastern gate, passing ma...
globaltix_product_data.description: Discover the charms of Old City Chiang Mai with 14 kilometers. Biking the back lanes and alleys experience the modern city alongside the ancient temples inside the walls of the old city. Begin your laid-back evening bike tour at 6.00 PM by heading towards the old city wall’s eastern gate, passing many of Chiang Mai’s quaint lanes. Arrive at the first stop, Tha Phae Gate, which was once the entrance through which traders brought their wares into the city. Learn more about Chiang Mai's history as a trading hub at this beautifully restored gate. Continue your ride through the spaghetti streets of the old city to the temple Wat Intakhin, with its serene 700 hundred year old white Buddha and the Three Kings Monument, where you will hear about the founding of Chiang Mai. Proceed with the tour to the city moat. Leaving the bikes by the side of the moat, walk across to Wat Lok Molee with its beautifully illuminated stupa and ornate wooden prayer hall. At this time of day you have a good chance of hearing the monks chanting their prayers. The next stop is Chiang Mai’s grandest monument: Wat Chedi Luang was built to house the ashes of a king and was once the home of the Emerald Buddha, now housing the City Pillar and 3 auspicious dipterocarp trees which provide protection to the city. Cycle to Chiang Mai’s Gate Market for the last stop and wander through the bustling night market. Walking through the market, your guide will point out the different types of street foods available. After selecting some food to sample, sit down with a drink and enjoy the night market atmosphere.
highlights: Visit the most famous sights after dark in the cool of the evening
Learn more about Chiang Mai's founding and its traditions
Enjoy tasting the local food in the Chiang Mai Gate Market area
Marvel at the city's famous monuments, such as the Wat Chedi Luang temple or the Three Kings Monument
Discover Chiang Mai’s old town on bike during night time

globaltix_product_data.description: Chiang Mai Night Safari offers a unique nighttime wildlife experience just outside the city. Visitors can enjoy an exciting tram safari through open habitats, where animals such as giraffes, zebras, lions, and other wildlife can be observed up close in a naturalistic setting after dark. The park is well known for its wide range of nocturnal animals, allowing guests to witness species that are most active at night. In addition to the tram ride, visitors can explore themed walking trails, including the Jaguar and Savanna zones, for a closer and more interactive wildlife encounter. To complete the evening, guests can enjoy entertaining performances such as the musical dancing fountain and light show, making it a memorable and family-friendly attraction that combines education, adventure, and entertainment in one destination.

globaltix_product_data.description: Elephant Jungle Sanctuary is a project that has set up ethical sanctuaries in Thailand. Visitors to the sanctuary will be able to feed, bathe and play with the animal visit. The Elephant Jungle Sanctuary is renowned as one of the top elephant sanctuaries in Chiang Mai, with a proven commitment to sustainable and ethical treatment of elephants. Our Chiang Mai reserve offers a variety of ways for visitors to connect with the magnificent elephants of Thailand. For those interested in a half-day elephant tour, we provide enriching experiences. Our knowledgeable English-speaking guides share insights into the elephants' behavior and personal histories, while the mahouts help guests engage in unforgettable activities like hand-feeding and bathing the elephants in Chiang Mai.
highlights: The Elephant Jungle Sanctuary is an ethical and sustainable eco-tourism project based in Thailand.
It was founded in July 2014 as a joint initiative between members of the Karen hill-tribes of Northern Thailand and Chiang Mai locals.
The sanctuary is located in 4 provinces throughout Thailand - Chiang Mai, Phuket, Pattaya, and Koh Samui.
They offer Half Day, Full Day, and Overnight Stay options to visit the sanctuary.
Visitors will have the opportunity to feed, bathe, and play with the elephants.

globaltix_product_data.description: The colourful past of Chinatown comes alive within the walls of these three beautifully-restored shophouses on Pagoda Street, comfortably nestled in the midst of Singapore's bustling Chinatown district. Every nook and cranny in the Chinatown Heritage Centre pulsates with the memories of yesteryear, offering an experience like no other as one is transported to Chinatown in the budding years of Singapore's establishment as a seaport. FAQ 1. How long should I plan to spend at the Chinatown Heritage Centre? The Chinatown Heritage Centre typically takes 45 mins to 1.5 hours to explore thoroughly. This allows visitors to immerse themselves in the multisensory exhibits, meticulously recreated shophouse interiors from the 1950s, and learn about the early migrants' journeys. If you enjoy reading all the information panels and watching the short films, you might spend closer to 2 hours to fully appreciate the content. 2. What are the operating hours and days for the Chinatown Heritage Centre? The Chinatown Heritage Centre is open daily from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, with the last admission at 7:15 PM. It’s always recommended to check their official website for the most current schedule. Operating hours or special closures might vary on public holidays or for maintenance purposes, so verifying in advance ensures a smooth visit. 3. What makes the Chinatown Heritage Centre a valuable experience for visitors to Singapore? The Chinatown Heritage Centre offers a unique and immersive insight into the lives of early Chinese migrants who settled in Singapore. Visitors can walk through meticulously restored shophouses and recreated interiors, experiencing the challenges and triumphs of a bygone era. The multisensory exhibits bring history to life, showcasing the resilience and spirit that shaped Singapore's diverse cultural landscape, providing a profound understanding of the nation's heritage. 4. What specific exhibits and historical recreations can I explore at the Chinatown Heritage Centre? At the Chinatown Heritage Centre, you can explore detailed recreations of early Chinese immigrants' living quarters and workshops, including a tailor shop, living cubicles, and kitchens. The exhibits feature personal artifacts, photographs, and interactive displays that narrate the arduous journeys and daily lives of these settlers. You'll also see beautifully conserved shophouses, offering a glimpse into Singapore’s architectural past and the vibrant community that once thrived there. 5. How can I get to the Chinatown Heritage Centre using public transportation in Singapore? The Chinatown Heritage Centre is conveniently located at 48 Pagoda Street, directly above the Chinatown MRT station. To get there, take the North East Line (purple line) or the Downtown Line (blue line) to Chinatown MRT station. Use Exit A (Pagoda Street), take a walk down the street for a couple of minutes and you'll find the centre on your right. This makes it highly accessible via Singapore's efficient public transport network. 6. What aspects of early Singaporean life are highlighted through the exhibits at the Chinatown Heritage Centre? The centre's exhibits vividly portray the harsh realities and community spirit of early Chinese immigrants in Singapore. It covers topics like their motivations for migration, the challenges faced in adapting to a new land, their trades and livelihoods, and the development of Chinatown as a bustling ethnic enclave. Stories of resilience, cultural preservation, and the formation of a vibrant community, including secret societies and clan associations, are central to the narratives presented. 7. Are there specific times or days when the Chinatown Heritage Centre is less crowded? To avoid larger crowds at the Chinatown Heritage Centre, it is generally best to visit on weekdays, particularly in the mornings right after opening (around 10:00 AM) or in the late afternoon before the last admission (around 6:00 PM - 7:00 PM). Weekends and public holidays tend to be busier due to increased local and tourist traffic, so planning your visit during off-peak hours can enhance your overall experience and allow for more leisurely exploration.

Take a ride aboard the modern, newly-refurbished cars of the Christchurch Gondola for some unmatched views of this popular New Zealand city. You'll rise above the suburbs of this picturesque city as you board the gondola at ground level and then head above all the local highlights, such as the Port Hills, the shimmering harbour of Lyttleton, and the Southern Alps in the distance. Once you've reached the top, you'll have the opportunity to participate and visit a number of different attractions, such as the Red Rock Cafe (a fully licensed venue ideal for enjoying a beverage and admiring the great views) or take a ride on the Time Tunnel (that showcases a reconstruction of the area's historical background). globaltix_product_data.description: Originally a hunting lodge, Château de Vincennes was the home of the French royal family for centuries, before they moved to the Palace of Versailles (and well before they were beheaded and banished). This historical compound has a moat, six towers, three gates, and a 52-meter tall keep - the tallest in Europe. This ticket includes access to all the key sights, and entitles you to enter via the priority entrance.Like the Tower of London and the other, farther out-of-town, former royal residences, a trip to the Château de Vincennes brings you up close to the tumultuous history of royal families in Europe.Located within Paris, the compound features a beautiful cathedral (although it was badly damaged during the French Revolution) and the highest fortified tower in Europe.And this site was the setting for some important historical events. The English King Henry V died of dysentery in the (tower), the relics of the Crown of Thorns were stored in the chapel before being transferred to Sainte-Chapelle in Paris and, during its time as a state prison, it held famous inmates including the Marquis de Sade, the philosopher Diderot, and the controversial Count of Mirabeau.Restored after suffering extensive damage during WWII, the renewed Château de Vincennes is a symbol of the modern French state; it's a beautiful modern location with a complicated history. Come and get some.

From the open-top deck you'll have a fantastic 360 degree view of the spectacular surroundings, which are a blend of stunning natural beauty, and wonderfully historic...
globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the historic and vibrant city of Edinburgh in your own time, with an award-winning unlimited 24 hour hop-on hop-off bus tour. From the open-top deck you'll have a fantastic 360 degree view of the spectacular surroundings, which are a blend of stunning natural beauty, and wonderfully historic architecture. This Scottish sightseeing adventure will take you to all of Edinburgh's key points of interest, including Waverley Bridge, Grassmarket, Johnston Terrace, Old Town, Canongate, Palace of Holyroodhouse, Our Dynamic Earth and much more! There's also an informative audio tour commentary on the double-decker bus, so you can make sense of the fabulous sights you're experiencing. With access to 14 stops around the city, and the ability to hop on and off the bus as much as you please within the given time period, you can truly immerse yourself into the culture of this charming destination.

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Each participant must enter their official full name and date of birth during the booking process. Failure to do so will result in denied entry at the monument. The entrance ticket fee to the archaeological sites is €16 for adults (€22 for the arena option), accompanied by a €2 reservation fee. The additional amount covers services provided by experienced licensed guides, audio devices, reservation fees, and other tour amenities. During July and August, the guided tour lasts 2 hours. All guests need to go through security checks before entering the Colosseum and Roman Forum. Please keep in mind that during high season, waiting time may be longer than usual. Tours will continue rain or shine. Our guides will ensure you have an enjoyable experience regardless of the forecast. If the full tour option is selected, the tour includes a visit to the Colosseum, Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill. The order of these visits can vary and may be subject to internal arrangements at the Colosseum.

globaltix_product_data.description: Get priority access to this former palace and riverside prison on Paris's medieval Île de la Cité. You’ll see prison cells from the French Revolution (including the cell of Queen Marie Antoinette), and the Gothic is Europe’s biggest medieval hall still in existence.History is soaked into the thick walls of this incredible Gothic building. Built as a royal palace in the 14th century, when the royal family decamped for fancier surroundings in the Louvre and Vincennes, it found new life as a prison. During the French Revolution it earned the chilling nickname "the antechamber to the guillotine". People accused of being an enemy of the republic would face a tribunal in the Great Hall, where they would either be acquitted, or found guilty of treason and sentenced to death. If convicted they would await their fate in one of the nearby cells. The wealthy would pay for relatively comfortable rooms with beds, while commoners were crammed into plague-infested haybed cells.The most famous resident during its stint as a prison was Queen Marie Antoinette. After the Restoration, her cell was converted into a chapel. A visit to her lockup is one of the highlights of a trip to this famous building. Other attractions include Europe's largest medieval hall, the , and the dreaded Bonbec Tower, which was a torture chamber. The name 'Bonbec' refers to the fact that prisoners who came here would confess to whatever they were being accused of ( means 'good' and meant 'mouth').A visit to the Conciergerie is a fascinating glimpse into the turbulent history of the French Republic. And unlike many of its residents, you're allowed to leave afterwards! The Conciergerie's past as a tribunal lives on in the present - parts of it now house the Paris Law Courts.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Crocodile Adventureland is home to around 4,000 young and mature species of crocodile, including Tomistoma, Siamese, Guinea, and the Saltwater Crocodile. The farm is also home to 'Bujang Lang', one of the world's largest crocodiles in captivity weighing in at 1,000 kilograms. Engage in several activ...
globaltix_product_data.description: Crocodile Adventureland is home to around 4,000 young and mature species of crocodile, including Tomistoma, Siamese, Guinea, and the Saltwater Crocodile. The farm is also home to 'Bujang Lang', one of the world's largest crocodiles in captivity weighing in at 1,000 kilograms. Engage in several activities including crocodile feeding and fishing, and come virtually face to face with life sized, crocodile like dinosaurs, in an interactive experience powered by animatronics technology.
highlights: Largest Collection of Crocodiles: The park is home to nearly 4000 crocodiles from various species such as Tomistoma, Siamese, Guinea, and Saltwater crocodile.
Educational and Entertaining: The park combines entertainment & education, featuring live shows that highlight the strength and agility of these reptiles.
Interactive Activities: The park offers interactive activities such as juvenile crocodile fishing and feeding.
Awards and Recognition: ‘Outstanding Eco Adventure Park’ by MyMalaysia Tourism in 2023.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Vietnam’s recent history is complex, so exploring Ho Chi Minh City’s wartime relics is best with a guide to explain them. globaltix_product_data.description: Vietnam’s recent history is complex, so exploring Ho Chi Minh City’s wartime relics is best with a guide to explain them. This full-day tour delivers: focusing on the 1955-1975 Vietnam War, with sightseeing on top. See the city’s colonial-era sights, chart the war in the photo exhibits of the War Remnants Museum, and explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, used by the Viet Cong to hide from and fight the enemy. Uncover Vietnam’s wartime past on a small-group tour from Ho Chi Minh City Dig deeper into the Vietnam War with a guide for detail and chronology Visit the War Remnants Museum and Cu Chi Tunnels. Start your day at 8:00 AM with Independence Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, and the Central Post Office. Explore history at the War Remnants Museum, then have lunch. In the afternoon, head to Cu Chi Tunnels for an immersive experience, including special tea and cassava. Optionally, try shooting a real gun. The tour ends at 7:00 PM in Saigon, a day filled with history and adventure.
highlights: Your knowledgeable guide will provide in-depth explanations, offering context and chronology, making your exploration of wartime relics more meaningful.
Explore the city's colonial-era landmarks, connecting the past to the war's history.
Witness the powerful photo exhibits at the War Remnants Museum, providing poignant insights into the war's impact.
Enjoy an intimate tour experience in a small group, allowing for a more personalized and engaging journey.

globaltix_product_data.description: Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary on the Gold Coast has long been one of the most popular attractions in south-east Queensland, and it isn't hard to see why. With great prices on tickets for the huge array of things to do, Currumbin Sanctuary offers one of the best value days out for families and individuals alike. Get up close with a ton of the best and cutest native Aussie and exotic wildlife at the many interactive displays and wide-open enclosures, while walking amongst the lush, comfortable eucalyptus and rainforest environments. All your animal favourites are here; you can cuddle up to and have your photo taken with a koala, get up close with crocodiles, hand-feed the many friendly kangaroos and much, much more. Be sure to stay around for the Rainbow Lorikeet feeding - one of the main attractions - with two demonstrations, morning from 8am and afternoon from 4pm. Buy your Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary tickets here to visit this ever-popular zoological facility that is located on the Gold Coast Highway at Currumbin, around 5 minutes from Gold Coast Airport and approximately 20 mins from Surfers Paradise. Open all year round (except Christmas and ANZAC Day), pay a visit to Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary today - you won't be disappointed.

globaltix_product_data.description: Elephant Mountain Pine Forest tourist area is about 15km from the center of Da Lat, about 12km from Lien Khuong airport along the highway, located right at the foot of Elephant Mountain in K'Long village, Hiep An commune, Duc Trong district. Lying comfortably along the slopes of Voi Mountain, wearing the green color of primeval jungle about 100 hectares wide, Elephant Mountain has an altitude of 1,756m. Entering that majestic scene is a cool climate all year round. When talking about Elephant Mountain, it is often associated with legends of the people of the Southern Central Highlands that have been told from generation to generation. Coming to Elephant Mountain Pine Forest Resort, you will be stunned by the incredibly rich biological system, ancient trees, countless colorful flowers, 7-storey waterfalls,... moreover, this is a conservation area. red pine - a rare tree population included in the red list for protection.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Darwin Royal Flying Doctor Service gives visitors a fascinating insight into two episodes of Australian history. Learn the history of the iconic Royal Flying Doctor Service and the shocking Bombing of Darwin in 1942 through an interactive virtual reality experience. Step inside this incredible facility and strap on the virtual reality headset to watch the drama unfold before your eyes on that fateful day in February 1942. Relive history as it is brought to life in a never before seen movie production. The museum also houses a full size Japanese Zero aircraft that hangs from the ceiling and interactive story boards, touchscreens and holograms of Commanding Officers that narrate their own version of events of the bombing. Visitors can also learn more about the activities of the aero medical service that has been helping Australians since 1939. The Royal Flying Doctor Service is a must see for locals and visitors alike to understand a piece of Australian history presented in an informative yet entertaining way. Audio headset translations are available in a variety of languages including Japanese, German, French and Simplified Chinese. The facility is open 7 days a week from 9.30am to 6pm. Purchase your tickets to the Darwin Royal Flying Doctor Service online here today! globaltix_product_data.description: Step into a world of invention and imagination with DaVinci and The Wheel of Time – Cinematic VR Walkthrough Experience by DF Experiences. This immersive attraction transports you through time into the mind of Leonardo da Vinci, where art, science, and innovation come to life in a fully interactive virtual environment. Combining cinematic storytelling with free-roam VR technology, you will physically walk through beautifully crafted historical settings, uncover hidden secrets, and interact with Da Vinci’s groundbreaking ideas. Designed as a multi-sensory journey, this experience blends education and entertainment, allowing you to explore history in a way that feels vivid, engaging, and unforgettable.

globaltix_product_data.description: Step beyond the screen and into a prehistoric adventure with Dino Rescue Squad – Cinematic VR Walkthrough Experience by DF Experiences. This cutting-edge immersive attraction lets you physically walk inside a cinematic dinosaur world, where survival, teamwork, and discovery come together in one thrilling journey. Unlike traditional VR, this experience combines cinematic storytelling with free-roam movement, allowing you and your team to explore different environments, encounter lifelike dinosaurs, and complete interactive missions in real time. Designed as a multi-sensory adventure, you are not just watching a story—you are inside it.

globaltix_product_data.description: Step into a world of joy! Can you imagine a space created just to delight your senses and stimulate dopamine? Welcome to Dopamine Land in Singapore, an interactive museum of dopamine-inducing sensory experiences. Explore a series of spaces designed to stimulate touch, sight, smell and even memory. Enjoy music, relax in meditative spaces, and channel the limitless imagination of your inner child. Enter a world of happiness—get your tickets for Dopamine Land: A Multisensory Experience in Singapore!
highlights: Pillow fights, interactive attractions, and many other blissful entertainment options!
Perfect for an outing with friends and family
Colourful settings and surroundings to capture some truly unique photographs
An interactive sensory museum designed to explore and trigger the happiness hormone dopamine
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Dopamine Land is an indoor interactive sensory experience combining media, technology, and play across multiple themed rooms. The experience is held in an indoor, air-conditioned venue. Virtual reality elements are included as part of the experience. Light snack items may be available for purchase on-site, subject to availability. The venue is wheelchair accessible; however, certain areas may have limited accessibility. Limited seating is available for rest. Children under 8 years of age must be accompanied by an adult. Toddlers aged 2 years and below may enter free of charge. Pets are not permitted, except for registered service animals. Personal photography and video recording are permitted provided other guests are not disturbed. Professional equipment and tripods are not allowed. Prohibited items include outside food and beverages (including alcohol), illegal substances, weapons, fire starters, unapproved materials, and pets (except service animals). There are no performers as part of the experience; however, light and non-intrusive interaction with staff may occur. Some exhibits may feature moving lights and special effects. Strobe lighting is not used. Merchandise may be available for purchase on-site, subject to availability.

globaltix_product_data.description: An Enchanting Rainforest Night Walk Where legends come to life As night falls, travellers are invited to enter the Dream Forest Book Portal and into the magical realm of Sang Gedembai, the legendary keeper of stories and Guardian of the Forest. Stroll along a leisurely 1.2km trail to discover tales like the bittersweet love story of Dayang Bunting Lake, the fabled battle between mighty warrior Merong Mahawangsa and his nemesis Garuda, and… did you know Langkawi was once the home of GIANTS? Immerse yourself in their stories through mesmerising lights, music, projection mapping, art installations, interactive activities and narration. Created by Tiara Jacquelina and the award-winning team at Enfiniti - storytelling, cutting-edge technology and nature come together to create an unforgettable experience. Are you ready for a magical journey?
highlights: Stroll along a leisurely 1.2km trail to discover Langkawi's mythical tales, brought to life through mesmerising lights, music, projection mapping
The 14 different zones are carefully designed around the natural environment and tell stories about Langkawi's rich history and folklore including the Legend.
This magical multi-sensory adventure is perfect for families with children of all ages.
There are discounts for Langkawi residents, MyKad holders, and senior citizens.
The park is open daily from 7pm to 12am, except for Wednesdays (unless it is a public or school holiday).

globaltix_product_data.description: Dreamworld Gold Coast is Australia’s largest theme park, located on the Gold Coast in Queensland. This multi-attraction destination combines thrilling rides, family-friendly experiences, and wildlife encounters all in one place, making it a top choice for visitors seeking a full day of entertainment. The park features a mix of adrenaline-pumping roller coasters, interactive zones, and educational wildlife exhibits for all ages. Visitors can explore several themed areas including Rivertown, Main Street, Tiger Island, and Kenny & Belinda’s Dreamland. From high-thrill rides like giant drop towers and roller coasters to gentle attractions for kids, the park offers a wide variety of experiences. In addition, guests can encounter native Australian wildlife such as tigers, crocodiles, and dingoes, blending theme park fun with conservation and education. The experience is typically a full-day visit and is self-paced. Guests enter by scanning their tickets at the gate and can enjoy unlimited access to rides and attractions throughout the day. Optional upgrades such as multi-day passes or access to nearby attractions like WhiteWater World are also available, depending on the ticket selected

globaltix_product_data.description: Why You Shouldn't Miss This The Dubai Dolphinarium is Dubai's go-to destination for a day of fun and enjoyment with your family. The adorable bottlenose dolphins, fur seals, and other wildlife will leave you amazed with their tricks and thrills. At the Dubai Dolphinarium, you also have a chance to interact with the Dolphins, catch the Dolphin & Seal show, free jump on the trampoline, and much more. Here, you will be able to enjoy a fun show of acrobatics, games, and tricks performed by dolphins and seals. Watch in wonder as they perform incredible acrobatics, dance, sing, juggle, play ball, jump through hoops and even paint! This show is an amazing 45-minute show where you can get up close and personal with these talented animals Your Experience The dolphin and seal show is a unique experience where you will see these amazing animals display their immense talents. From juggling and playing with a ball to diving on command, the dolphin and seal show is sure to win your hearts. The show takes place in the main show pool which is surrounded by an arena-style seating, with regular and VIP sections. Dubai Dolphinarium tickets are available with VIP seating and Regular seating options. VIP Seating : The VIP seats are in the center of the arena and provide the best viewing point for the show. Regular Seating: The regular seats are laid out on both sides of the VIP seats in an arc. Note: If you have purchased regular tickets, then seating is on a first-come-first-served basis. Try arriving at least 15 minutes before the show to get the best seats for the show.

globaltix_product_data.description: On the Traditional Dubai Tour, you will enjoy a short but rich journey through the customs, traditions and ways of living that continue to thrive in Old Dubai. Start your journey with a convenient pick-up from your hotel, followed by a smooth transfer to the iconic Jumeirah Mosque. From there, enjoy a scenic drive to the majestic Zabeel Palace for a memorable photo opportunity. Wander through the historic Al Fahidi District, where traditional buildings and cultural exhibits bring Dubai's past to life. Experience a charming Abra boat ride across the Dubai Creek, leading you to the bustling Spice Souk. Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of the Gold & Spice Souqs, the heart of old Dubai's commerce. After exploring, we'll head back to the Jumeirah Mosque, and then to Souk Madinat, where you can capture stunning photos of the iconic Burj Al Arab. Enjoy lunch at your own leisure with various dining options available. Conclude the tour with a comfortable return transfer to your hotel. This tour offers a half day of cultural exploration and stunning photo stops through the city's vibrant heritage!

globaltix_product_data.summary: Edinburgh Castle, perched dramatically atop Castle Rock, is one of Scotland’s most iconic landmarks and a symbol of the nation’s history and heritage. With origins tracing back over a thousand years, the fortress has served as a royal residence, military stronghold, and seat of power, witnessing cou...
globaltix_product_data.description: Edinburgh Castle, perched dramatically atop Castle Rock, is one of Scotland’s most iconic landmarks and a symbol of the nation’s history and heritage. With origins tracing back over a thousand years, the fortress has served as a royal residence, military stronghold, and seat of power, witnessing countless battles and historic events. Its striking position offers commanding views of the city below, while within its walls lie treasures such as the Honours of Scotland (the Scottish Crown Jewels) and the Stone of Destiny, both deeply tied to the country’s monarchy. Today, the castle stands not only as a reminder of Scotland’s turbulent past but also as a vibrant cultural attraction, drawing visitors from around the world to explore its rich architecture, storied past, and breathtaking vistas.
highlights: One of Scotland’s top attractions, offering panoramic city views.
Home to the Honours of Scotland (Scottish Crown Jewels).
Served as a royal residence, military fortress, and seat of power.
Holds the Stone of Destiny, used in royal coronations.
Perched atop Castle Rock, it dominates the Edinburgh skyline.

globaltix_product_data.description: The stage at Tablao Flamenco Cordobés is recognised among the most demanding professionals as one of the most outstanding venues in the history of flamenco tablaos. Founded in 1970 by a family of artists, it has welcomed flamenco legends in Barcelona for more than five decades, establishing itself as a global benchmark for flamenco shows in Barcelona. This rich legacy continues today with our new venue, El Duende by Tablao Flamenco Cordobés. El Duende is an intimate and welcoming space, created with the same passion and artistic commitment that brought Cordobés to international fame. Designed as a flamenco bar and cocktail lounge in the heart of Barcelona, El Duende offers live flamenco performances by leading artists, including emerging talents who are shaping the future of flamenco. Its program reflects a deep respect for tradition, while also giving space to new creative voices, supporting young artists and projects that explore the dialogue between flamenco and other musical languages. Each night offers a different flamenco experience, making El Duende an ideal choice for those seeking live flamenco in Barcelona with a fresh and contemporary atmosphere. With a glass of wine in your hand, our invited artists will captivate you with an individual recital full of art and talent, transporting you for 50 minutes to the deepest roots of this traditional art

Accompanied by a professional guide, climb secure stairways and elevated walkways before crossing a thrilling suspension bridge suspended above the dramatic limestone cliffs. Reach the observation deck to enjoy panoramic views of El Nido town, the crystal-clear waters of Bacuit Bay, and its surrounding islands. For an extra dose of excitement, you can also try the optional Dream Net experience. Combining adventure, spectacular scenery, and unforgettable photo opportunities, this activity is perfect for travelers looking to experience one of El Nido's most iconic viewpoints.

Capture incredible photos from one of El Nido's most scenic viewpoints, making it a must-visit attraction for adventure seekers and photography enthusiasts.

options.description: Entry to Abu Dhabi’s First Private Zoo Prepared to be blown away as you make a visit to the region’s first of its kind zoo. It is a vast, lush space where over 1,700 animals co-exist in a setting that replicates their natural habitat. There are close to ten sections that give you the rare chance to delight in the sights and sounds of some intriguing creatures that fall under almost all categories, including wildcats, primates, herbivores, mammals, birds and reptiles. Get Up Close and Personal with Several Amazing Farm & Wild Animals Head to the Wildlife Walk – an indoor walkway that is fully air-conditioned; from the mighty Bengal Tigers and rescued Cheetahs to the endangered Amur Leopards, it brings you closer to some of the wildest animals from all over the world. At Primate Paradise, catch up with some cool species of monkeys like Blue Monkey, Tufted Capuchin, Velvet Monkey etc. The dedicated Bird Park hosts specialties like Laughing Kookaburra, African Grey Parrots and Red-Winged Macaw. More amazing inhabitants await you its other sections such as Animal Paradise, Flamingo Park, Reptile House, and Petting Zoo. Take Your Zoo Experience to the Next Level With the choice of right tickets, you can make your trip to this zoo as immersive and informative as possible. Add interactive sessions, enjoy cool games with Zoo Zip and Climb, or feed your favorite animals such as adorable goats, hippos, monkeys, and giraffes. You can also choose from a variety of culinary experiences that are definite to enrich your zoo experience, mainly Big Cat Brunch, Breakfast with Parrot, and Dinner with Elephants. globaltix_product_data.summary: Enoshima aquarium is a popular aquarium located along the Shonan coast in Fujisawa city, Kanagawa prefecture, where visitors can enjoy the charm of the ocean along with the beautiful views of Sagami bay and Enoshima island stretching out before them. globaltix_product_data.description: Enoshima aquarium is a popular aquarium located along the Shonan coast in Fujisawa city, Kanagawa prefecture, where visitors can enjoy the charm of the ocean along with the beautiful views of Sagami bay and Enoshima island stretching out before them. The facility features exhibits focused on the diverse marine life inhabiting Sumo Bay, allowing visitors to learn about ocean ecosystems while enjoying the experience. One of the biggest highlights is the "Sumo Bay large tank," where you can observe fish swimming in schools within a powerful space that recreates the natural ocean. Additionally, Enoshima Aquarium is also famous for its jellyfish exhibits. At the "Jellyfish Fantasy Hall," you can observe the beautiful sight of jellyfish swimming gracefully under fantastical lighting. There are also exhibits where you can learn about jellyfish ecology and growth, making it a place where you can experience both relaxation and learning. The dolphin show is another popular program. Against the backdrop of Enoshima and the sea of Konan, you can enjoy the dolphins' dynamic jumps and their perfectly synchronized performances with the trainers, creating moving experiences for many visitors. Enoshima aquarium is not just a place to see marine life, but also an aquarium that provides opportunities to think about the ocean environment and the importance of life.
highlights: Explore Sagami Bay marine life – Discover diverse ocean species and learn about the marine ecosystem through engaging exhibits.
Visit the Sagami Bay Large Tank – Watch schools of fish swim through a large-scale recreation of the natural ocean environment.
Discover the Jellyfish Fantasy Hall – Relax as graceful jellyfish drift through beautifully illuminated displays.
Enjoy dynamic dolphin shows – Watch dolphins perform impressive jumps and synchronized routines with their trainers.
Scenic coastal setting – Enjoy aquarium experiences alongside beautiful views of Sagami Bay and Enoshima Island.

globaltix_product_data.description: Spot koalas, kangaroos, manatees, giant pandas, and over 6,000 other animals in France's number one zoo. With excellent shows and entertainment for kids – plus pandas so fascinating you could stop and stare for hours – this dose of animal magic is a guaranteed awesome family day out. Explore the tropics inside a massive 12,000m² equatorial dome with manatees, Komodo dragons, and more. See the animals of South America, Asia, and Africa, and enjoy a 360° view of the dome from up high. ZooParc de Beauval is the only zoo in France with giant pandas. But that's not all: it's home to the largest diversity of animals in the whole country (over 6,000 of our furry and scaly friends live here)! Take your time and catch some shows. Les Maîtres des Airs sees 200 birds flying over your heads (you may want to wear a hat), while L’Odyssée des Lions de Mer features a bunch of friendly sea lions showing off for you. Head to the hippopotamus reserve, spot Simba and pals in La terre des lions, and new in the park, see pandas, Arctic wolves, and cheetahs. And it's not just the extensive range of species, the zoo is dedicated to conservation and the habitats are wide-open, with energetic animals making full use of the space. It's fuzzy, four-legged edutainment at its finest, and if the animals could speak, they'd speak in French. What's not to love?

Ride a cable car 35 meters above the park, and see two rare giant pandas found nowhere else in France
Watch incredible live shows featuring flying birds and sea lions - fabulous fun for the whole family (March - September)
Expect good times at the number one zoo in France, plus the cutest pandas

globaltix_product_data.description: It looks straight out of a fantasy film - as if dragons might swoop down as you enter. But you haven't stepped into a parallel universe - you've just discovered the Abbaye du Mont Saint-Michel. This astounding World Heritage Site lies just off the rocky coast of Normandy. It's a medieval must-see! Explore 20 rooms, stunning gardens, and get panoramic views of the sea and sky.Le Mont Saint-Michel is a small island commune in Normandy, and the Abbaye du Mont Saint-Michel is most definitely its crowning glory, looming over it all like a big stone soldier as the waves crash on its rocky shores. The worship of Archangel Michel first occurred in this spot in 708 AD, making it 'the' place for a medieval pilgrimage.In the 10th century the Benedictine monks realized its importance and promptly set about building a proper abbey here. In 1874 the abbey was listed as a historic monument; this was after the monks said their goodbyes in 1790. It draws as many crowds today as it did hundreds of years ago - thanks to its airy interior and majestic position.With over 20 rooms and spires and towers looming over the town below, there's plenty to explore. You can also join a guided group for free - just ask when you arrive and you'll be placed in a group for a tour. As you walk around the abbey, take the chance to watch the tide roll in and out (it has Europe's highest tidal variations, swelling and dropping as much as 15 meters in as little as six hours). Reaching the summit of the abbey will reward you with unbelievable panoramas; you'll feel like the king of a French castle. Or the abbot of a French abbey.
highlights: See Europe's greatest tidal variations (up to 15 meters in six hours) from a 13th-century religious compound
Get a free guided group visit to explore the abbey and see where Archangel Michel has been worshiped since 708 AD
Visit a crucial medieval pilgrimage site and a UNESCO World Heritage Site on an island off the coast of Normandy

globaltix_product_data.summary: Skip the line to one of Italy's most important Roman-Gothic style buildings - the magical Cathedral of Siena. Marvel at the frescoes by Donatello, Michelangelo, and Pinturicchio. See the Crypt and the Piccolomini Library, and don't forget to check out the floor. It's made of 56 panels of inlaid marb...
globaltix_product_data.description: Skip the line to one of Italy's most important Roman-Gothic style buildings - the magical Cathedral of Siena. Marvel at the frescoes by Donatello, Michelangelo, and Pinturicchio. See the Crypt and the Piccolomini Library, and don't forget to check out the floor. It's made of 56 panels of inlaid marble mosaics and is one sight you won't forget.Housing some of the most important European artistic monuments, the Roman-Gothic style Cathedral of Siena makes for a meaningful morning. Over a million visitors every year step through these stunning doors - it's just as spectacular as Florence's Duomo.Skip the line and get up close to amazing frescoes by the likes of Donatello, Michelangelo, and Pinturicchio. They're all here in what is one of the most important examples of this style of building in Italy, constructed between 1214 and 1263. See the Crypt, the Baptistery and the Museo dell'Opera, all of which form the (Old Cathedral), and the (New Cathedral) and check out the Piccolomini Library, dedicated to Pope Pius II.Oh, and don't forget to look down. The floor is an art piece in itself, with 56 scenes engraved in marble, which were carved between 1369 and 1547 by 40 different artists. You'll step lightly, but the complexity is staggering!
highlights: Admire the Cathedral of Siena - one of the most treasured examples of the Gothic-Roman style in Italy
See stunning frescoes by Donatello, Michelangelo, Pinturicchio and more!
Visit the impressive Piccolomini Library, which was dedicated to Enea Silvio Piccolomini, Pope Pius II, and frescoes by a young Raphael

globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel with a skip-the-line entrance ticket. Visit the Raphael Rooms, Gallery of Maps and immerse yourself into the fascinating world of art and historical artefacts. After meeting your host (NOT Tour Guide), you will enter the main hall without waiting in line and have the opportunity to explore the museums at your own pace. Discover the marble sculpture Laocoön and His Sons at the Museum Pio-Clementino, one of the renowned museum spaces within the complex. Next, see the famous Belvedere Torso, Round Hall, and the Raphael Rooms. Admire the unique theme and frescoes depicting various scenes and subjects. Continue to the Sistine Chapel, renowned for the remarkable frescoes by Michelangelo. You will be amazed by the masterpieces of Michelangelo, Botticelli, Ghirlandaio, and other Renaissance artists. Marvel at the beautiful collection of ancient sculptures, Renaissance paintings, tapestries, manuscripts, and archaeological findings. Enjoy a remarkable visual journey into the world of the Renaissance at your own pace.

Visit highlights such as the Raphael Rooms, the Gallery of Maps, and the impressive Pio-Clementino Museum, where you can admire masterpieces like Laocoön and His Sons and the famous Belvedere Torso. Explore the Round Hall and other remarkable galleries filled with ancient sculptures, Renaissance paintings, tapestries, manuscripts, and archaeological artifacts. globaltix_product_data.summary: Spanning 12.5 acres in the cool, scenic mid-hills of Genting Highlands, our floral, magical land is designed to spark curiosity, joy, and a deep connection to the natural world. Escape to the cool climate of Genting Highlands and experience nature in full bloom, perfect for families, couples, and we...
globaltix_product_data.description: Spanning 12.5 acres in the cool, scenic mid-hills of Genting Highlands, our floral, magical land is designed to spark curiosity, joy, and a deep connection to the natural world. Escape to the cool climate of Genting Highlands and experience nature in full bloom, perfect for families, couples, and weekend explorers. Designed to inspire a deep connection with nature, Eufloria Gardens & Sculpture Park serves as a space for learning, exploration, and wonder, through thoughtfully designed exhibits, interactive tours and educational programmes. Our aim is for visitors to cultivate a sense of awe and respect for the environment while providing a serene escape from everyday life. Let’s rediscover the magic of nature. Explore the GardenZodiac Pavilion See the giant sculptures, feel the mist and marvel at a towering indoor waterfall surrounded by a lush tropical oasis. Rainforest Grove Breathe in the earthy air, admire the lush greenery as you allow the rainforest to revitalise your mind and body. Garden of the Seasons Experience a garden that’s always in bloom. With flowers that change every few months, no two visits are ever the same. Enchanted Orchard Step into a living sanctuary where the air is scented with ripe fruit, and every corner is alive with texture and colour. Here, fruit trees flourish in a space designed to awaken your senses and calm your spirit. Harmony Garden 和园 (He Yuan) A sanctuary of stillness, let its quiet magic restore your spirit and awaken inner peace. The Living Market Learn, explore, and bring home a piece of the garden. Discover essential tools and seedlings for every gardener.
highlights: Let the symphony of nature’s hues and the crisp mountain air transport you to tranquillity and wonder within Eufloria Gardens & Sculpture Park
Engage in educational exhibits, interactive tours, and programmes that promote conservation and environmental awareness.
Discover immersive experiences with giant sculptures, indoor waterfall, lush rainforest, and sensory-rich environments.
Spanning 12.5 acres in the cool mid-hills of Genting Highlands, this floral wonderland inspires curiosity, joy, and a deep connection to nature.
Enjoy serene spaces like Harmony Garden and Enchanted Orchard, blending relaxation, nature, and cultural inspiration.

Your experience includes - option 1: tickets for the flamenco show in an authentic “tablao”, - option 2: tickets for the flamenco show + one drink, - option 3: tickets for the flamenco show + tapas tasting menu, tapas tasting menu. Everything is arranged so you can simply relax and enjoy the journey.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Discover the natural beauty of Nusa Penida on a memorable one-day tour from Bali. This full-day adventure takes you across turquoise seas to one of Bali’s most spectacular neighboring islands, famous for its dramatic cliffs, crystal-clear waters, and iconic viewpoints. Travel comfortably by fast boa...
globaltix_product_data.description: Discover the natural beauty of Nusa Penida on a memorable one-day tour from Bali. This full-day adventure takes you across turquoise seas to one of Bali’s most spectacular neighboring islands, famous for its dramatic cliffs, crystal-clear waters, and iconic viewpoints. Travel comfortably by fast boat from Sanur Harbour and explore Nusa Penida’s top attractions, including breathtaking coastal landscapes, hidden beaches, and scenic viewpoints. Depending on the selected itinerary, you may visit famous spots such as Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, Angel’s Billabong, and Crystal Bay, or enjoy an exciting snorkeling experience at selected marine spots. Designed for travelers who want a hassle-free day trip, this package includes fast boat transfers, local transportation on the island, an experienced guide, and lunch. Whether you’re traveling solo, with friends, or family, this tour offers the perfect way to experience Nusa Penida in just one day.
highlights: Choose between East Nusa Penida, West Nusa Penida, or Combination Island Tour
Enjoy comfortable return fast boat transfers from Sanur Harbour, Bali
Visit iconic destinations such as Kelingking Beach, Diamond Beach, Broken Beach, and Angel’s Billabong
Travel around the island with a private air-conditioned vehicle and driver-guide
Includes lunch, entrance tickets, and Nusa Penida retribution fee for a hassle-free experience

globaltix_product_data.name: Girona and Tossa de Mar Day Trip from Barcelona
globaltix_product_data.summary: This beautifully crafted day trip from Barcelona visits two of Catalonia's most distinctive and rewarding destinations — the remarkably preserved medieval city of Girona and the stunning Costa Brava coastal town of Tossa de Mar — combining the architectural richness of one of Spain's finest historic...
globaltix_product_data.description: This beautifully crafted day trip from Barcelona visits two of Catalonia's most distinctive and rewarding destinations — the remarkably preserved medieval city of Girona and the stunning Costa Brava coastal town of Tossa de Mar — combining the architectural richness of one of Spain's finest historic city centres with the azure Mediterranean beauty of one of the most picturesque fortified coastal villages in Europe. Girona's extraordinarily intact medieval heritage — the Jewish Quarter of El Call, the Romanesque and Gothic Cathedral, the colourful houses of the Onyar riverbank, and the ancient city walls — creates one of the most rewarding and photographically beautiful historic city experiences in all of Spain. Tossa de Mar provides the day's most visually spectacular and emotionally immediate encounter with the Costa Brava's legendary coastal beauty — its medieval fortified walls and towers rising directly from the rocky Mediterranean headland above a bay of translucent blue water that has drawn artists, writers, and travellers since Marc Chagall famously described it as a 'blue paradise'. The contrast between Girona's urban medieval richness and Tossa de Mar's dramatic coastal setting creates a day of exceptional geographical and aesthetic variety that reveals the extraordinary diversity of Catalonia's cultural and natural landscape within a single thoroughly satisfying excursion from Barcelona.
highlights: Enjoy expert commentary from a professional licensed guide
Comfortable round-trip transportation by bus from Barcelona
Guided visit through the historic old town of Girona
Explore the Jewish Quarter (Call Jueu), one of the best preserved in Europe
Comfortable round-trip transport included from the meeting point
Free time to explore the Vila Vella and enjoy the seaside
Visit Tossa de Mar, a gem of the Costa Brava

Accompanied by a professional local guide, you’ll embark on a scenic journey to the iconic Montserrat Mountain, home to the 11th-century Benedictine Monastery. Return to Barcelona Depart from Montserrat and enjoy a comfortable ride back to the city center. End of tour.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The From Krakow: Auschwitz-Birkenau Guided Tour & Hotel Pickup is a full-day historical and educational experience that takes visitors from Krakow to the Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial and Museum, one of the most significant UNESCO World Heritage Sites in the world. globaltix_product_data.description: The From Krakow: Auschwitz-Birkenau Guided Tour & Hotel Pickup is a full-day historical and educational experience that takes visitors from Krakow to the Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial and Museum, one of the most significant UNESCO World Heritage Sites in the world. This guided tour offers a deeply moving journey into history, providing insight into the Holocaust and the events of World War II through expert-led narration. Traveling in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle with optional hotel pickup, guests will reach the memorial site in Oświęcim, where a licensed historian guide leads a comprehensive tour of both Auschwitz I and Auschwitz II-Birkenau. Visitors will walk through original barracks, prison blocks, and memorial grounds, gaining a powerful understanding of the lives, suffering, and stories of those who were held there. The experience lasts approximately 7–10 hours and follows a fixed schedule with pre-booked entry tickets to ensure a smooth visit. Guests are picked up from their hotel or a central meeting point, transferred to the site, and guided through both camps (around 3.5 hours total), before returning to Krakow—making it a structured yet impactful day trip

globaltix_product_data.summary: This comprehensive full-day tour from Madrid visits three of Spain's most historically significant and architecturally extraordinary medieval cities — Toledo, Segovia, and Ávila — in a single masterfully managed itinerary that reveals the extraordinary depth of Castilian heritage concentrated within...
globaltix_product_data.description: This comprehensive full-day tour from Madrid visits three of Spain's most historically significant and architecturally extraordinary medieval cities — Toledo, Segovia, and Ávila — in a single masterfully managed itinerary that reveals the extraordinary depth of Castilian heritage concentrated within easy reach of the Spanish capital. Toledo, the former imperial capital of Spain, enchants with its labyrinthine old city of Gothic cathedrals, Moorish mosques, and Jewish synagogues rising dramatically above the Tagus River gorge — a UNESCO World Heritage cityscape of extraordinary multicultural richness. Segovia's iconic Roman aqueduct — two millennia of engineering genius spanning the city's historic centre in 166 perfectly preserved arches — and the fairy-tale turrets of the Alcázar castle that inspired Walt Disney's Sleeping Beauty provide two of Spain's most immediately memorable architectural encounters. Ávila, encircled by the most completely preserved medieval city walls in the world, adds a third dimension of atmospheric medieval grandeur to a day that most guests describe as the finest single-day experience of Old Castile's extraordinary historical legacy.

globaltix_product_data.name: Toledo and Segovia from Madrid Full Day Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: This expertly managed full-day excursion from Madrid visits two of Spain's most historically significant and visually extraordinary medieval cities — Toledo and Segovia — combining the multicultural imperial heritage of the former Castilian capital with the Roman engineering marvel and fairy-tale ca...
globaltix_product_data.description: This expertly managed full-day excursion from Madrid visits two of Spain's most historically significant and visually extraordinary medieval cities — Toledo and Segovia — combining the multicultural imperial heritage of the former Castilian capital with the Roman engineering marvel and fairy-tale castle architecture of one of Old Castile's most beloved destinations. Toledo's UNESCO World Heritage old city rises dramatically above a bend in the Tagus River in a dense and atmospheric layering of Gothic, Moorish, Jewish, and Renaissance architecture that reflects its extraordinary history as a city where Christian, Muslim, and Jewish cultures coexisted and created together during the golden centuries of the medieval period. Segovia provides the perfect complement to Toledo's medieval urban richness — its magnificent Roman aqueduct, built in the first or second century AD and still standing in remarkable completeness across the city's historic centre without a drop of mortar binding its 20,000 granite blocks, representing one of the most astonishing feats of ancient engineering surviving anywhere in Europe. The Alcázar de Segovia — its distinctive prow-shaped silhouette and fairy-tale turrets rising above the confluence of two rivers — provides the day's most romantically cinematic architectural encounter before the return journey to Madrid.
highlights: Explore Toledo’s medieval streets with a professional guide
Enjoy a delicious traditional lunch if you select the option
Discover two UNESCO World Heritage cities in one day
Admire Segovia’s stunning Roman Aqueduct and fairytale Alcazar
Enjoy expert commentary from a professional licensed guide
Relax with comfortable round-trip transport from Madrid
Visit top landmarks like Toledo Cathedral and Alcazar of Segovia

options.name: departure
options.description: Escape from civilization to one of the most beautiful natural destinations in **New Zealand** - **Doubtful Sound**, a massive, incredibly scenic fiord brimming with scenery, cascading waterfalls, native wildlife and much more. This Doubtful Sound wilderness cruise will take you to this compelling destination for an excursion across the lovely Lake Manapouri after which you'll hop aboard a coach and travel the sub-alpine road over Wilmot Pass then witness the dense **Fiordland** rainforest and view Doubtful Sound glimmering in the distance below. Once we reach the Sound itself, you'll board a spacious vessel to kick off a three-hour cruise through some of the area's astounding scenery as your accompanying experienced nature guide provides commentary and answers any questions you might have. During the cruise be sure to keep your eyes open for the many varieties of wonderful wildlife that inhabit the region including fur seals which can be seen basking in the sun or bottlenose dolphins which inhabit Doubtful Sound's waters. globaltix_product_data.description: Erawan Patong Zipline is located in the jungle mountains overlooking Patong Beach, one of Phuket’s most famous beaches. Under the guidance of our experienced guides, you can enjoy an exhilarating zipline adventure through lush tropical rainforest while taking in the stunning views of the clear, white, beautiful beach and blue sea. The entire area spans approximately 176,000 square meters and includes various features such as tree houses, bird nests, bridges, abseil ziplines, skyboard, and more. It also boasts the longest zipline in Phuket, stretching over 700 meters, offering an exhilarating flight with breathtaking views of Patong Beach. At Erawan Patong Zipline, you will experience the harmony between humans and nature. All our facilities are environmentally friendly, and after experience, you are inveited to plant a seed in the rainforest, contributing to the preservation of the natural environment. While enjoying these thrilling activities, your safety is our top priority. We use PETZEL safety equipment that meets European and American safety standards. Children aged 4 and there is a maximum weight limit of 120 kg. above can participate under the supervision of our experienced and friendly guides.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Fiordland's **Doubtful Sound** is a geographically huge destination packed with stunning natural beauty; with these **overnight cruises**, you'll be able to immerse yourself in its breathtaking scenery and spend the night while anchored in a sheltered cove to extend the experience an additional day!...
globaltix_product_data.description: Fiordland's **Doubtful Sound** is a geographically huge destination packed with stunning natural beauty; with these **overnight cruises**, you'll be able to immerse yourself in its breathtaking scenery and spend the night while anchored in a sheltered cove to extend the experience an additional day! The journey will begin when you board the **cruise yacht** - the **Fiordland Navigator** - that awaits you at the beginning point of your Doubtful Sound cruise, and we head off to cruise the full, impressive length of the fiord and weave through its hidden coves and waterways. During your time on the water, keep your eyes peeled for local wildlife that inhabit the area including bottle nose dolphins, fur seals, rare penguins and more. The chance to go swimming will also present itself as we drop anchor, or perhaps explore the shoreline by kayak. In the evening, enjoy a delicious meal prepared by our onboard chef and relax in the saloon before you head to your cosy bed. **NOTE:** This option also includes coach transfers from Queenstown.
highlights: Kayaking and exploring by tender craft
Leisurely exploration of Doubtful Sound
Wildlife viewing opportunities
Traditional style motor vessel with staysail schooner-rigged sails
Launch transfers across Lake Manapouri

globaltix_product_data.name: Doubtful Sound Wilderness Cruise from Queenstown
globaltix_product_data.summary: Take the hassle out of getting to your Doubtful Sound wilderness cruise with this package that includes the cruise itself along with coach transfers from Queenstown. With the cruise itself, you will escape from civilization to one of the most beautiful natural destinations in New Zealand - Doubtful...
globaltix_product_data.description: Take the hassle out of getting to your Doubtful Sound wilderness cruise with this package that includes the cruise itself along with coach transfers from Queenstown. With the cruise itself, you will escape from civilization to one of the most beautiful natural destinations in New Zealand - Doubtful Sound, a massive, incredibly scenic fiord brimming with scenery, cascading waterfalls, native wildlife and much more. This Doubtful Sound wilderness cruise will take you to this compelling destination for an excursion across the lovely Lake Manapouri after which you'll hop aboard a coach and travel the sub-alpine road over Wilmot Pass then witness the dense Fiordland rainforest and view Doubtful Sound glimmering in the distance below. Once you reach the Sound itself, you'll board a spacious catamaran to kick off a three-hour cruise through some of the area's astounding scenery as your accompanying experienced nature guide provides commentary and answers any questions you might have. During the cruise, be sure to keep your eyes open for the many varieties of wonderful wildlife that inhabit the region including fur seals which can be seen basking in the sun or bottlenose dolphins which inhabit Doubtful Sound's waters.

options.name: doubtful sound cruise ex queenstown
options.description: Take the hassle out of getting to your **Doubtful Sound wilderness cruise** with this package that includes the cruise itself along with coach transfers from **Queenstown**. With the cruise itself, you will escape from civilization to one of the most beautiful natural destinations in **New Zealand** - **Doubtful Sound**, a massive, incredibly scenic fiord brimming with scenery, cascading waterfalls, native wildlife and much more. This Doubtful Sound wilderness cruise will take you to this compelling destination for an excursion across the lovely Lake Manapouri after which you'll hop aboard a coach and travel the sub-alpine road over Wilmot Pass then witness the dense **Fiordland** rainforest and view Doubtful Sound glimmering in the distance below. Once you reach the Sound itself, you'll board a spacious catamaran to kick off a three-hour cruise through some of the area's astounding scenery as your accompanying experienced nature guide provides commentary and answers any questions you might have. During the cruise, be sure to keep your eyes open for the many varieties of wonderful wildlife that inhabit the region including fur seals which can be seen basking in the sun or bottlenose dolphins which inhabit Doubtful Sound's waters. Inclusions * Full day Doubtful Sound Wilderness Cruise and Coach package from Queenstown * Luxury launch cruise across Lake Manapouri and coach trip over Wilmot Pass * Three hour full length cruise of Doubtful Sound on a modern, spacious catamaran with excellent viewing * Wildlife viewing opportunities including fur seals, dolphins and rare Fiordland crested penguin * Expert commentary * Interpretation hand-out sheets in 5 languages: English, German, French, Spanish and Japanese * Dedicated nature guide with specialist knowledge of flora and fauna * Complimentary tea and coffee on board Exclusions * Meals. Picnic lunches available for purchase from Manapouri Café. Snacks and drinks available for purchase (cash only onboard) * Packed lunch can be purchased prior to your cruise. Please contact the supplier after booking Itinerary * On boarding a luxury coach in Queenstown, travel along the shores of Lake Wakatipu and through the rolling countryside to Manapouri * Then cruise across the crystal waters of Lake Manapouri to West Arm before boarding a coach and crossing the alpine route of Wilmot Pass through some of Fiordland’s most dense rainforest. On reaching Deep Cove, board a modern catamaran vessel, the Patea Explorer for a three hour cruise exploring the waterways of this serene and isolated fiord * There is plenty of time available to explore points of interest and view the spectacular alpine scenery including waterfalls, rainforest and mountains all the way out to the Tasman Sea * It is home to bottlenose dolphins and fur seals and when in season, the rare Fiordland crested penguin. An on-board nature guide with specialist knowledge of the region’s history, flora and fauna provides detailed interpretation in English with a roving microphone Extras * Picnic lunch is available for an additional $20.00 each. This must be pre-ordered (cut off at 4pm on the day before travel) * Snacks are available for purchase on board only i.e. chips, chocolate, biscuits etc (cash only) Highlights * Cruise across the crystal clear Lake Manapouri to West Arm * Coach trip through Fiordland's rainforest and over Wilmot Pass * 3 hour cruise on Doubtful Sound, a pristine, beautiful fiord * View rugged peaks, verdant rainforest and hidden inlets * Spot dolphins, fur seals and the rare Fiordland crested penguins * Dedicated nature guide * Expert commentary * Doubtful Sound is 3 times longer than Milford Sound * Luxury coach transfers from Queenstown Time * Tours depart Queenstown daily at approximately 6.55am at return at 7.30pm Hotel Pickup * Some hotel pick ups are offered for this tour and are available from most centrally located Queenstown hotels. If a hotel pick up is required, please contact the operator 48hrs prior to departure to arrange pick up location. If a hotel pick up is not required, please meet the tour at the RealNZ Visitor Centre, 88 Beach Street, Queenstown for a 6:55am departure What To Bring * Non-slip shoes/boots * Waterproof jacket * Warm sweater/fleece jacket * Sunscreen/sunglasses * Insect repellent * Camera Booking Information * Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking * Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of the experience * For your information, complete Tour Operator Information including contact details is included on your tour voucher * Availability was accurate at the time of booking, however, is subject to change due to circumstances out of our control. globaltix_product_data.summary: Head to the Skytropolis Indoor Theme Park in First World Plaza for an exciting, all-day adventure! globaltix_product_data.description: Head to the Skytropolis Indoor Theme Park in First World Plaza for an exciting, all-day adventure! Embrace the thrills and frills of the park, surrounded by beautiful Genting Highlands. Start your adventure by exploring the expansive indoor theme park. Test your limits and make sure to hop on one of their many exhilarating rides. Spin around on their colorful Royal Carousel or take a heart-stopping plunge on the Sky Towers at gravity-defying speeds. The possibilities are endless! Rides Introduction: Family Rides: Boo Boo Bump - A fun miniature bumper car ride where children can gently bump their way around. Parental supervision is required at all times. Riders must be between 105cm and 140cm in height. Ride ‘Em Round - A classic merry-go-round with seats that move up and down, perfect for children. Parental supervision is required at all times. Riders must be between 90cm and 122cm in height. Copper Express - A family-friendly open-top train ride with mild curves. Riders under 80cm in height are not permitted. Children between 80cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Tea Cups - An oversized spinning tea cup ride offering multiple twirling motions for the whole family. Riders under 105cm in height are not permitted. Children between 105cm and 130cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Chariot Cruise - A family-friendly flying cruise that loops around the park. Riders under 110cm or over 195cm in height are not permitted. Children between 110cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Adventure Rides: Loop de Loop - A miniature track ride with gentle curves and slopes, designed for children. Parental supervision is required at all times. Riders must be between 90cm and 122cm in height. Balloon Race - A family-friendly balloon ride featuring fast spins and twirls. Riders under 80cm in height are not permitted. Children between 80cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Royal Carousel - A grand, double-story carousel adorned with intricately carved horses and chariots. Riders under 80cm in height are not permitted. Children between 80cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Space Cadets - A family-friendly ride with controllable flying motions, allowing guests to pilot their own adventure. Riders under 80cm in height are not permitted. Children between 80cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Soaring Ships - A suspended ride that offers breathtaking aerial views of the park, perfect for the whole family. Riders under 80cm in height are not permitted. Children between 80cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Sky Towers - An exhilarating drop tower ride that plunges at gravity-defying speeds. Riders under 105cm in height are not permitted. Children between 105cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Skyscraper - A towering Ferris wheel with colorful gondolas, offering a magnificent panoramic view of the park. Riders under 90cm in height are not permitted. Children between 90cm and 122cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Thrill Rides: Disco! - A gigantic spinning disc that swings back and forth while rotating rapidly, gaining speed as it travels. Riders under 122cm in height are not permitted. Spin Crazy - An extreme spinning pendulum that soars through the air with thrilling 360-degree rotations. Riders under 130cm or over 195cm in height are not permitted. Super Glider - A suspended lie-down coaster featuring sharp turns, sudden drops, and high-speed curves—perfect for thrill-seekers. Riders under 135cm in height are not permitted. Power Surge - A high-intensity ride with wild spinning motions and upside-down thrills. Riders under 122cm in height are not permitted. Music Express - A fast-spinning ride with sudden slopes, twirling motion, and a thrilling backward surge. Riders under 130cm in height are not permitted. Children between 130cm and 140cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. Bumper Boss - A dynamic bumper car arena where guests can unleash their inner racer. Riders under 120cm in height are not permitted. Children between 120cm and 130cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion aged 16 or above with a valid wristband or ticket. The Bolt - A family-friendly rollercoaster that takes riders to the highest peak of Skytropolis, offering a bird’s-eye view of the park while navigating through gentle dips and turns. Guests under 130cm and above 190cm in height may not ride.
highlights: Rides and Attractions: The park spans over 400,000 sq ft and offers more than 20 rides for the whole family.
Embrace the thrills and frills of the park, surrounded by beautiful Genting Highlands.
Family Rides: Enjoy family rides with family such as Boo Boo Bump, Ride ‘Em Round, Copper Express, Tea Cups, and Chariot Cruise.
Adventure Rides: Enjoy adventure rides such as Loop de Loop, Balloon Race, Royal Carousel, Space Cadets, Bumper Boss, Music Express, Power Surge etcs.
Thrill Rides: Enjoy thrill rides such a Disco!, Spin Crazy and Super Glider.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Golden Dragon Water Puppet Theater is a cultural performance venue in Ho Chi Minh City showcasing Vietnam’s traditional water puppetry. The show takes place on a shallow water stage where puppets appear to move, dance, and “swim” across the surface, controlled by hidden puppeteers behind a bamboo screen. The performance is accompanied by live traditional Vietnamese music and singing, bringing folk stories, daily rural life scenes, and legends to life in a highly visual and entertaining format.

globaltix_product_data.name: Grévin Wax Museum
globaltix_product_data.summary: Hundreds of wax figures in unexpected tableaux, magic shows in the museum's matchbox theater and baroque architecture, this is right out of a whimsical French film.Before Madame Tussauds moved to London to create her famous museum, she inspired journalist Arthur Meyer to create something similar in...
globaltix_product_data.description: Hundreds of wax figures in unexpected tableaux, magic shows in the museum's matchbox theater and baroque architecture, this is right out of a whimsical French film.Before Madame Tussauds moved to London to create her famous museum, she inspired journalist Arthur Meyer to create something similar in the French capital. With the help of noted caricaturist Alfred Grévin, this museum came to life (). With more than 450 lifelike wax sculptors arranged into dynamic (and sometimes morbid) tableaux, and its listed 1900s decor (marble staircase, cupola, and baroque-style Hall of Columns), this is a throwback to the Paris of your imagination. Since its opening in 1882 this Parisian attraction has been drawing homegrown crowds - it's estimated that more than 70% of the visitors are French. The scenes are by turns historically informative, and incredibly whimsical. Tableaux from the glory days of French history, including the coronation of Charles VII (with Joan of Arc in attendance), Sun King Louis XIV living it up at a party at Versailles, and Napoleon Bonaparte, in his post-Waterloo days. On top of the many figures and surprising tableaux, the recently renovated Hall of Mirrors is noteworthy for its optical illusions and dazzling light and sound effects. The tableaux of Charlotte Corday's arrest for assassinating radical Revolutionary Jean-Paul Marat uses the actual knife used in the killing, and the actual bathtub Marat was stabbed in. Since opening in 1882, the museum has had only one unscheduled closure - on the day the Nazis invaded Paris.
highlights: Experience a uniquely Parisian attraction in this star-studded museum, there's a lot more here than waxworks!
Step into realistic, immersive experiences with celebrities, sports stars, politicians, and historical figures
Explore scenes from 19th and 20th-century France, and even learn how the wax figures are made on a free tour
