globaltix_product_data.description: Go behind the scenes at the Optus Stadium in Perth on this 90 minute HALO rooftop walking tour. Perth’s largest sporting stadium offers one of the best vantage points of the city and is a must-do activity for sports fans. Join guides on a trip up to Level 5 via a staircase to the famous sails. If you prefer a ride in the lift, that can be arranged too. Elevated above the stadium, guests can enjoy a 360 degree walk around the rooftop as you discover insider knowledge about game day operations and the construction of the stadium. Access to the Western Viewing Deck is included in the HALO rooftop tour with spectacular views of Derbal Yerrigan (Swan River) and Perth City. The HALO rooftop walk is suitable for guests who are looking for an enjoyable walk in one of the world’s most beautiful and technologically advanced stadiums without the heart-racing adrenaline rush that the VERTIGO rooftop tour offers.
highlights: Enjoy breathtaking views of Perth City from the Western Viewing Deck
90 minute rooftop walk at Optus Stadium
Complimentary branded cap and group photo
Behind-the-scenes access to Optus Stadium rooftop
Feel the thrill of reaching the top of one of Australia's largest stadiums
Safe and secure guided tour with insider knowledge

globaltix_product_data.summary: Welcome to the world of Harry Potter like you've never experienced before. The show that has thrilled fans around the world and won theater awards around the world, Harry Potter and the Cursed Child, is being performed by the original Japanese cast. You can ""experience"" the world of "Harry Potter"...
globaltix_product_data.description: Welcome to the world of Harry Potter like you've never experienced before. The show that has thrilled fans around the world and won theater awards around the world, Harry Potter and the Cursed Child, is being performed by the original Japanese cast. You can ""experience"" the world of "Harry Potter", created by bringing together the skills and techniques of the world's leading entertainment staff, in the theater. A story that can be enjoyed by both fans of the original and non-fans, various magic spells that pop up one after another, stage design and costumes that will immerse you in the world of Harry Potter, original and exciting music, everything you experience calls you into a magical space.
highlights: Watch the award-winning play "Harry Potter and the Cursed Child" with its original Japanese cast.
Immerse yourself in stage design and costumes that bring the world of Harry Potter to life.
Enjoy original and exciting music that enhances the magical atmosphere.
Be amazed by numerous magical spells that come to life on stage.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Ticket valid only on the day of the performance. Children in preschool are not admittable. Baby strollers are not allowed. On the day of the performance, please present a photo ID with the purchaser's photo. If you have purchased tickets for ages 6 to 15, please also present an ID that verifies the age. Tickets can be redeemed 1 hour before the start of the performance Entry is permitted 40 minutes before the start of the performance. Seat numbers can be confirmed on the tickets redeemed on the day of the performance. Requests for designated seats in advance are not available. We apologize for any inconvenience. Ticket types and seat changes are not allowed. Re-entry is permitted. Please present your ticket again for re-entry. Beverages without lids are not allowed in the audience area, and flash photography is prohibited.

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience Unlimited Fun with the Kansai Pass 1 Week Free Pass! Welcome to a world of enchanting beauty, captivating history, and exhilarating adventures. Embark on a memorable journey through the vibrant region of Kansai, Japan, with the Kansai Pass 1 Week Free Pass. This remarkable pass is your gateway to unlimited fun, allowing you to explore the very best of Kansai at your own pace. Discover Iconic Landmarks: Immerse yourself in the rich cultural heritage of Kansai as you visit its iconic landmarks. Marvel at the majestic Osaka Castle, an imposing symbol of power and elegance that dates back to the 16th century. Experience the spiritual tranquility of Kyoto's renowned temples, such as the breathtaking Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion) and the serene Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine. Feel the pulse of modernity as you wander through the bustling streets of Kobe, renowned for its vibrant atmosphere and delicious cuisine. Unleash Your Inner Adventurer: With the Kansai Pass 1 Week Free Pass, the region becomes your playground. Unleash your inner adventurer as you traverse the picturesque landscapes of Kansai. Journey to the mesmerizing Mount Yoshino, renowned for its breathtaking cherry blossoms in spring, or hike through the rugged beauty of Mount Koya, a UNESCO World Heritage site known for its ancient temples and pristine nature trails. Whether you're a nature enthusiast or seeking thrilling urban escapades, Kansai offers something for everyone. Convenient and Hassle-Free: The Kansai Pass 1 Week Free Pass makes exploring the region a breeze. globaltix_product_data.name: Hoi An Memories Show
globaltix_product_data.summary: Hoi An Memories is a spectacular outdoor cultural performance held nightly on a riverside stage beside the Thu Bon River in Hoi An, Quang Nam Province. Featuring over 500 performers, the show showcases Hoi An's rich history and cultural heritage through traditional Vietnamese dance, music, elaborate...
globaltix_product_data.description: Hoi An Memories is a spectacular outdoor cultural performance held nightly on a riverside stage beside the Thu Bon River in Hoi An, Quang Nam Province. Featuring over 500 performers, the show showcases Hoi An's rich history and cultural heritage through traditional Vietnamese dance, music, elaborate choreography, visual effects, and stunning stage production. Presented across five acts, the performance tells the story of Hoi An's evolution from a historic trading port to one of Vietnam's most iconic cultural destinations. Combining immersive storytelling with impressive live performances, Hoi An Memories offers an unforgettable evening experience for visitors of all ages.
highlights: Enjoy stunning visual effects, immersive stage design, and the picturesque Thu Bon River as part of the performance setting.
Be captivated by a soundtrack that blends traditional Vietnamese music with contemporary orchestration, enhancing the show's emotional storytelling.
Spend an unforgettable evening in Hoi An with a world-class cultural performance showcasing the city's history, traditions, and artistic heritage.
Experience one of Vietnam's largest outdoor cultural performances, featuring over 500 performers on a spectacular riverside stage along the Thu Bon River.
Discover Hoi An's rich heritage through a captivating performance that traces its journey from the ancient Cham Kingdom to its thriving trading port era.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Important Information Guests are advised to arrive early to explore Hoi An Memories Land's themed areas, gardens, and cultural exhibits before the main performance begins. The venue is open-air. Guests should bring insect repellent and dress comfortably for the evening humidity typical of Central Vietnam's coastal climate. Photography and video recording for personal non-commercial use is welcome. Professional equipment and flash photography during the show may be restricted. Food and beverages are available at on-site outlets within Hoi An Memories Land before the show. Outside food and drinks may not be permitted inside the seating area. The performance includes fire effects, loud percussion, and dramatic lighting sequences. Guests with sensory sensitivities should consider this before attending.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Huangpu River Cruise is the definitive way to experience Shanghai’s soul, offering a front-row seat to the city’s dramatic evolution. By sailing between the Puxi and Pudong banks, you witness a stunning visual dialogue between the 19th-century colonial elegance of The Bund and the neon-lit, futu...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Huangpu River Cruise is the definitive way to experience Shanghai’s soul, offering a front-row seat to the city’s dramatic evolution. By sailing between the Puxi and Pudong banks, you witness a stunning visual dialogue between the 19th-century colonial elegance of The Bund and the neon-lit, futuristic skyscrapers of Lujiazui. Whether viewed under the morning sun or during the spectacular nightly light show, the cruise provides a panoramic perspective of the "Museum of Buildings" and the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower that simply cannot be matched from the shore
highlights: See the "Museum of Buildings" on the west bank. This row of 52 colonial-era structures showcases stunning Art Deco and Gothic architecture from Shanghai’s earl
Witness the world’s most futuristic skyline on the east bank. You’ll get a clear view of the Shanghai Tower and the World Financial Center towering over the riv
Get an up-close look at this iconic landmark. Its unique "pearl" design and colorful LED displays make it the most recognizable silhouette in the city.
The best part is the nighttime illumination. At 7:00 PM, the buildings light up, turning the river into a glowing reflection of gold and neon
The cruise shows you "old" and "new" Shanghai at once. It’s the only spot where you can see the 19th-century history and 21st-century future side-by-side.
exclusions: Child tickets for children under 0.8–1.29m in height are available for purchase onsite at CNY 150.

Designed to make art and culture accessible to all, IMBA presents large-scale exhibitions powered by light, motion, sound, and imagination—creating imme...
globaltix_product_data.description: Located within the iconic Gardens by the Bay, IMBA Theatre is a new cultural destination where curiosity, creativity, and technology come together. Designed to make art and culture accessible to all, IMBA presents large-scale exhibitions powered by light, motion, sound, and imagination—creating immersive experiences that transform the way you see the world. One of its headline showcases is The World’s Biggest Botero Experience, featuring three unique presentations: Botero: Heart of Volume (Gallery Exhibition), Botero: A Life in Fullness (Immersive Experience), and Botero: Garden Grandeur. Discover over 100 paintings, drawings, and sculptures that explore Botero’s signature style, alongside a groundbreaking immersive journey narrated by the artist’s son, offering rare insight into his life and legacy. IMBA Theatre also presents David Hockney: Bigger & Closer (not smaller & further away) — the first-ever David Hockney immersive experience in Southeast Asia. Through sweeping projections and immersive soundscapes, this vibrant showcase spans six decades of Hockney’s work, inviting visitors to step inside the artist’s creative vision. Blending art, storytelling, and cutting-edge technology, IMBA Theatre delivers a multi-sensory cultural experience unlike any other in Singapore.
highlights: Bring your little ones to explore Botero’s playful world at IMBA. Every child ticket comes with a free Botero activity set. (14–31 March 2026, TNC Apply.)
